jobs.title: Senior Manager Corporate Strategy
jobs.location: Spring, Texas, United States of America
jobs.description:
Senior Manager Corporate Strategy

This role has been designed as ‘Hybrid’ with an expectation that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

Defines high-impact, long-term (i.e., 2-5+ year horizon) business strategies at the corporate, business, and/or regional level. Partners with senior management to identify existing operational and new business opportunities, including market development, investment prioritization, and Mergers & Acquisitions and other growth strategies. Monitors external factors during strategic development, including market forces, macro/microeconomic factors, and competitive implications. Works with and manages cross-functional project teams. Conducts rigorous, data-driven analyses to diagnose the current state and model future outcomes for business performance. Develops recommendations for senior management based on competitive market, financial, statistical, and economic trend data. Manages corporate strategy initiatives and participates in communicating the strategy to the client organization.

Responsibilities:
- Identifies research, tools, and analyses required to achieve objectives for large, complex business strategy projects.
- Structures analytical approaches and develops project strategies and tactics.
- Develops recommendations for optimizing business and financial performance.
- Manages large, cross- functional teams and communications to facilitate projects and ensure timely delivery to clients.
- Leads the development of project guidelines, contingency plans, objectives, and deliverables.
- Consults with business executives on a wide range of issues related to the strategy formulation process, including risk management and new growth opportunities.
- Provides thought leadership and contributes to expanding the knowledge base within area of expertise which includes developing new methods, techniques and criteria for developing strategy analysis and recommendations.
- Collaborates across businesses, functions, and regions to align strategy and direction with corporate and divisional approaches, systems, information and support.

Experience and Education:
- Often 4-7 years post- advanced degree experience leading projects, deals, and company financial improvement initiatives in management consulting, corporate strategy, investment banking, or market research.
- Typically 7+ years of Consulting experience, Corporate Strategy experience, or Investment Banking experience
- Experience in Corporate Strategy, Investment Banking, or Consulting required
- Advanced university degree (e.g., MBA) preferred.

Knowledge and Skills:
- Excellent analytical thinking, analysis, and problem solving skills
- Ability to communicate abstract ideas clearly and independently manage complex project objectives
- Extensive knowledge of and ability to manage statistical analysis and financial modeling.
- Advanced business acumen, technical knowledge within at multiple business units, and extensive knowledge in applications and technologies.
- Very strong verbal and written communication skills, including negotiation, presentation, and influence.
- Superior group facilitation, interviewing, and influence skills.
- Excellent project management skills, including project structuring and managing multiple work streams independently.
- Strong relationship management skills, including partnering and consulting.
- Strong leadership skills, including coaching, team- building, conflict resolution, and management.
- Ability to identify and draw on leading-edge analytical tools and techniques to develop creative approaches and new insights to client issues.
- Ability to independently draft and present client deliverables, recommendations, and communications strategies.

What We Can Offer You:

Health & Wellbeing
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion
We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Join us redefine what’s next for you.

What you’ll do:

We are looking to hire a Six Sigma Black Belt into the Quality Methods team to lead various data analysis activities and support a number of exciting Quality improvement initiatives in the HPE Networking Business Unit
- Black Belt leads and manages Six Sigma project portfolios in order to accomplish measurable business process improvements. Employs Six Sigma methodology and analytics into organizational operations.

- Lead & Project Manage large Cross functional initiatives to Improve Customer Experience & Quality
- Lead Postmortem (Lessons learnt) activity for Critical Escalations & Field Issues
- Responsible for the analysis and  summary  of findings from studies for the purpose of  decisions  regarding various parameters like Quality, Efficiency, Cost reduction, Customer Satisfaction
- Provide Yellow belt and Green belt training to potential candidates and upon request from the business.
- Provide strong project management skills, expertise in quality management and ability to make major changes in organization – not let things fall through the cracks
- Change management – Drive sustainable change through the organization through collaboration and cross function work. Establish process, procedures to ensure sustainability of project results

What you need to bring:

Skills and Competences
- Six Sigma Black Belt Certified with 5 yrs. of experience leading Six sigma projects
- Proficiency with statistical techniques, flow charting, business analysis and experience in engineering, supply chain and customer success / services environment in technology industry.
- Proficient using statistical software like Minitab, SAS, Stata, R etc.
- Proficient in Machine learning techniques and application into quality related projects
- Knowledge of Python to extract and manipulate data sets to perform complex data analysis is a plus
- Prior experience of working in an outsourced supply chain environment with contract manufacturers
- Prior experience of working and/or incorporating six sigma  techniques and methodologies into the normal way of doing things versus through a "big program"
- Prior experience of managing and facilitating cross functional improvement projects (drive projects and results with the teams that not directly reporting into your function)
- Strong communication skills to manage cross-functional teams and stakeholders across the globe
- Ability to enable organization to become more self-sufficient and self-sustaining in process improvement endeavors
- Ability to influence peer groups and senior executives, and work with globally to distributed teams and functions
- Ability to coach and mentor other resources about six sigma methodology and drive a culture of quality in the organization
- Project Management (PMP) a plus
- Master’s Degree desirable
- Experience with other continuous improvement methodologies like Kaizen, Lean etc.
- Moderate travel will be required
- Self starter with ability to manage projects independently & ability to flexibly work with stakeholders across globe

Additional Skills:

Accountability, Accountability, Active Learning, Active Listening, Bias, Business Growth, Client Expectations Management, Coaching, Creativity, Critical Thinking, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Customer Centric Solutions, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Design Thinking, Empathy, Follow-Through, Growth Mindset, Information Technology (IT) Infrastructure, Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Intellectual Curiosity (Inactive), Long Term Planning, Managing Ambiguity, Process Improvements, Product Services, Relationship Building {+ 5 more}

OEM Business Planning & Strategy Manager

This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

Lead pricing strategy and price book management for key OEM accounts, translating business priorities into profitable growth, margin expansion, and long-term customer value. Drive strategic pricing decisions through financial modeling, market insights, and cross-functional alignment while serving as a trusted advisor to customers and executive stakeholders.

In this role, you will build financial models, evaluate investment and pricing tradeoffs, and generate actionable insights that enable leaders to make informed decisions. You will partner closely with customers, sales, finance, category management, and executive leadership to align pricing strategy with business objectives, operational execution, and customer success.

Management Level Definition:
Lead workstreams, align cross-functional teams, and apply sound judgment to drive clear recommendations and disciplined execution. Own decisions, navigate ambiguity, and escalate strategically when needed.

Responsibilities:
- Lead strategic business analysis to identify growth opportunities, improve profitability, and support executive decision-making.
- Develop advanced financial models, scenario analyses, and business cases to evaluate pricing strategies, investments, and opportunities.
- Drive the planning lifecycle from assumptions and inputs through approval, execution, and readout.
- Partner with executive leadership to provide actionable insights, recommendations, and data-driven decision support.
- Evaluate market trends, competitive dynamics, and customer requirements to develop forward-looking pricing and business strategies.
- Maintain strong customer relationships through regular communication and alignment on priorities, expectations, and business needs.
- Own customer pricing governance, including pricing frameworks, approval processes, margin optimization, and price book strategy.
- Lead initiatives that improve operational effectiveness, pricing governance, and business performance.
- Translate corporate strategy into disciplined pricing execution while balancing customer advocacy, financial goals, and stakeholder alignment.

Education and Experience Required:
- 4–6 years of experience in strategy, planning, operations, finance, pricing, or a related function.
- Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Knowledge and Skills:
- Strong strategic thinking with the ability to connect market trends, customer requirements, and financial performance to business decisions.
- Advanced financial modeling, forecasting, profitability analysis, and scenario planning capabilities.
- Ability to translate complex data into executive-level recommendations and compelling business narratives.
- Learn quickly, adapt to new methods, and apply insights to practical business challenges.
- Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power BI, financial analysis, and business intelligence tools.
- Connect data, business context, and financial implications to support sound decisions.
- Communicate clearly and confidently through concise, compelling narratives.
- Manage projects effectively through planning, prioritization, execution tracking, and stakeholder updates.
- Build trusted relationships and partner effectively across functions, levels, and geographies.
- Communicate effectively across cultures with clarity, professionalism, and awareness.
- Lead cross-functional teams, drive alignment, and maintain momentum through ambiguity.

The strategy is not based on individual Customer Success roles or coverage models. It will define how the broader organization delivers a consistent and differentiated experience across onboarding, adoption, support, renewal, and expansion.

- Partner across Services, Sales, Support, Product, Delivery, Renewals, and Digital Experience to align customer outcomes and priorities.
- Establish success measures for adoption, value realization, customer health, retention, renewal, expansion, and advocacy.
- Lead governance and execution across a complex, global, matrixed organization.

- Leadership experience in Customer Success, customer experience, SaaS, services strategy, or technology services.
- Experience developing global customer lifecycle or Customer Success strategies.
- Strong understanding of SaaS adoption, customer health, recurring revenue, retention, and expansion.
- Experience integrating digital engagement, analytics, automation, and human interactions.
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional transformation and influence senior stakeholders.

- Experience in enterprise networking, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, or technology services.
- Experience with services segmentation, support differentiation, entitlements, or installed-base strategies.
- Familiarity with CRM, Customer Success platforms, digital experience tools, telemetry, analytics, and AI.

Job Description:

About the Role

HPE Financial Services (HPEFS) is seeking a Senior Program Manager, Strategic Digital Initiatives to lead the business-side execution of a large-scale digital platform program that enables new capabilities, modernizes operations, and improves customer and partner experiences. Reporting to the Digital Strategy Leader, this role is accountable for integrated delivery of the assigned initiative across business, product, operations, technology, data, change management, Finance, and external partner teams.

The Senior Program Manager translates approved strategic   objectives   into an executable, integrated program   plan   and drives delivery from planning through platform implementation, launch, stabilization, adoption, and value realization. The role   operates   within the enterprise product operating model, governance standards, planning cadence, and delivery frameworks   established   by Product Operations & Governance and the broader Transformation Office.

This position is suited to a leader who thrives in ambiguity, builds alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, and drives disciplined execution in a highly matrixed environment.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Program Leadership

- Lead integrated business execution for an assigned large-scale digital platform initiative within established enterprise planning and governance frameworks.

- Develop and   maintain   the integrated program plan, milestones, success measures, decision log, and cross-workstream delivery plan for the assigned initiative.

- Monitor scope, schedule, budget, risks, issues, decisions, and dependencies, and drive   timely   mitigation or escalation.

- Apply   the product operating model, governance standards, planning cadence, and delivery controls defined by Product Operations & Governance and the broader enterprise program.

Business Outcomes and Value Realization

- Develop and   maintain   the business case, benefits framework, measurable outcomes, and value realization plan in partnership with Finance and business leaders.

- Track progress against expected business, customer, partner, and operational outcomes and recommend corrective action when needed.

- Ensure digital platform investments translate into sustainable operational improvements and measurable value.

Cross-Functional Integration

- Orchestrate execution across Product Management, Operations, Technology, Data, Process Engineering, Compliance, Finance, Change Management, and external partners.

- Manage interdependencies across workstreams and   establish   clear ownership, decision rights, and escalation paths.

- Facilitate issue resolution and   maintain   alignment between business priorities and technical delivery.

Product and Business Delivery Alignment

- Partner with Product Managers, Product Owners, and business leaders to align strategic   objectives , customer needs, operational requirements, and delivered platform capabilities.

- Facilitate initiative-level sequencing and trade-off recommendations based on approved product priorities, business value, risk, readiness, and dependencies; escalate portfolio-level prioritization decisions to the   appropriate product   and governance leaders.

- Maintain traceability between program   objectives , business requirements, delivered capabilities, and measurable outcomes.

Initiative Governance and Executive Communication

- Coordinate initiative-level steering committee materials, decision forums, and leadership reviews in alignment with established enterprise governance standards and cadence.

- Prepare concise executive status updates, decision materials, recommendations, and escalation summaries.

- Provide transparent reporting on   delivery   health, value, financials, risks, dependencies, readiness, and decisions.

Vendor and Strategic Partner Management

- Coordinate day-to-day business-side engagement with implementation partners, consultants, and vendors supporting the assigned initiative.

- Monitor vendor commitments, deliverables, performance, dependencies, and alignment to program outcomes.

- Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance, Technology, and the   appropriate business   owner on initiative-specific contract deliverables, commercial issues, and value delivery; use established sourcing and RFP frameworks.

Platform Readiness, Launch, and Adoption

- Coordinate business readiness for platform deployment, including process alignment, data readiness, execution of business testing, training, communications, support models, and adoption planning.   Apply   the enterprise UAT framework and standards owned by Product Operations & Governance.

- Partner with Product, Operations, Technology, and Change Management teams to plan go-live, stabilization, and transition to ongoing operations.

- Monitor adoption, stakeholder feedback, and early-life performance, and drive actions needed to achieve expected outcomes.

Budget and Financial Oversight

- Manage program budgets, forecasts, funding requirements, and financial reporting for the assigned initiative.

- Monitor expenditures against approved plans and business case assumptions,   identify   variances, and recommend corrective action.

- Support investment governance and responsible stewardship of program resources.

Role Boundaries and Key Partnerships

- Product Operations & Governance owns the enterprise product operating model, portfolio planning cadence, governance standards, delivery-health framework, product enablement practices, UAT framework, and common RFP standards. This role applies those standards to the assigned initiative and provides   timely   program data and insights.

- Product Managers and Product Owners own product vision, roadmap, backlog, feature prioritization, and product acceptance. This role integrates their plans with the broader program and manages cross-workstream dependencies, risks, and milestones.

- The IT Program Manager owns technical delivery planning and execution. This role owns integrated business delivery, stakeholder alignment, business readiness, vendor coordination, and value realization for the assigned initiative.

- The broader Transformation Office owns enterprise-level program governance, cross-program integration, and overall transformation outcomes. This role   represents   and delivers the assigned digital initiative within that structure.

Education and Experience Required

- First-level university degree or equivalent experience; advanced university degree preferred in Business, Information Systems, Technology, Program Management, or   a related   field.

- Typically   8+ years of experience leading complex business, digital, operational, or technology-enabled programs.

- Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale digital platform implementations, modernization programs, or technology-enabled business initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, vendors, and cross-functional teams.

- Demonstrated success coordinating business, operational, product, technology, data, and vendor stakeholders through implementation, go-live, stabilization, and adoption.

- Experience developing business cases, managing budgets,   establishing   governance, and driving value realization.

- Experience supporting platform   selection , implementation, migration, rollout, or operational readiness initiatives preferred.

- Experience   operating   in a highly matrixed environment with executive-level stakeholders.

- Financial services, leasing, banking, fintech, or enterprise technology experience preferred.

Knowledge and Skills

Strategic Program Management

Digital Platform Delivery

Enterprise Program Leadership

Cross-Functional Leadership

Executive Stakeholder Management

Governance and Decision Management

Business Case Development

Value Realization

Business Readiness and Adoption

Vendor Implementation Management

Budget and Financial Management

Risk and Dependency Management

Change Management

Product and Business Alignment

Large-Scale System Implementation

Executive Communication

Negotiation and Influencing

Leadership Without Authority

Additional Skills

Accountability, Active Listening, Business Acumen, Collaboration, Critical Thinking, Customer Focus, Data-Driven Decision Making, Financial Acumen, Growth Mindset, Influencing Skills, Managing Ambiguity, Outcome-Based Requirements, Prioritization, Program Governance, Relationship Building, Strategic Thinking, and Vendor Management.

Job Description:

The Global Hotel Program Manager is responsible for leading the strategy, sourcing, and ongoing management of HPE’s global hotel program within a large, complex organization. This role develops and executes category strategies that optimize spend, enhance the traveler experience, and ensure compliance with corporate policies.

The manager oversees supplier selection, contract negotiation, and performance management across a diverse portfolio of hotel partners, leveraging data-driven insights, market intelligence, and strong supplier relationships to drive value.

As a subject matter expert, this role collaborates cross-functionally with internal stakeholders, travel management companies, and suppliers to deliver cost savings, improve program adoption, and mitigate risk. The role also leads RFP processes, manages supplier relationships (including quarterly business reviews), and continuously evolves the hotel program in alignment with business needs and industry trends.

How you will make your mark :
- Define annual objectives and milestones to ensure successful execution of the hotel program strategy
- Lead the end-to-end annual RFP process, including defining requirements, developing bid packages, and facilitating bidder conferences

- Lead supplier selection activities and provide final recommendations based on strategic, financial, and operational criteria
- Negotiate and execute supplier contracts to achieve optimal commercial outcomes
- Develop and implement strategies for chainwide hotel agreements
- Drive top-quartile compliance with the preferred hotel program
- Build and maintain relationships with global stakeholders to leverage local market insights and improve program performance

- Oversee long-term accommodation requests to ensure alignment with program standards and cost efficiency
- Manage third-party provider relationships (e.g., rate assurance), including performance tracking and savings realization
- Leverage reporting and analytics to expand discount availability and inform sourcing strategies
- Monitor and resolve escalated hotel service issues, including quality, payment, and safety concerns
- Develop and execute Online Booking Tool (OBT) strategies to optimize hotel display and promote preferred suppliers
- Communicate program goals, updates, and strategies to internal stakeholders, travel agencies, and external partners
- Engage travelers and arrangers through communication channels such as intranet content, training sessions, and supplier events
- Represent HPE within the hotel and travel industry; attend conferences as appropriate
- Track and report savings performance, including maintaining savings tools and providing regular updates
- Support supplier partnership initiatives, including Mutual Value Partnership (MVP) engagements
- Expand knowledge across broader travel categories to serve as a cross-functional subject matter expert
- Support additional team initiatives and projects as needed

- Bachelor’s degree
- 6-8 years of relevant experience in the hotel or travel industry
- Fluent in English
- Strong global/geographical knowledge
- Ability to comply with in-office work guidelines

Knowledge and Skills:
- Strong knowledge of the travel industry, particularly hotel sourcing and corporate travel programs
- Proven relationship-building and stakeholder management skills
- Effective negotiation and contract management capabilities
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Ability to develop forecasts, plans, and strategic recommendations
- Adaptability and interest in leveraging evolving technologies (e.g., automation, AI tools)
- Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills
- High attention to detail with a proactive, curious mindset
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (e.g., Teams, SharePoint, Copilot, Excel)

Who We Are:

Job Description:

This is an opportunity to join HPE’s world-class Global Communications team. With scores of communicators across the globe, we advocate for HPE's corporate strategy, business innovation, and thought leadership.

We're looking for an experienced and strategic Enterprise Thought Leadership Program Management Lead to help scale HPE's enterprise thought leadership program, which is a key pillar of the Corporate & Financial Communications team designed to connect HPE within the most influential conversations shaping the technology industry.  This role sits at the intersection of communications, marketing, and business strategy and partners with external leading media organizations and event platforms. By showcasing HPE’s innovation, we position HPE as a leading voice on the trends transforming enterprise technology in the AI era, and work to enhance our company’s reputation, credibility, and business impact.

This is an ideal opportunity for a highly collaborative communicator who excels in shaping and managing operational aspects of a highly visible program. We are seeking a candidate with demonstrable leadership qualities who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys creating new structures and workflows, and can translate strategy into measurable business impact.

The successful candidate will work in a close-knit group of high-performing colleagues that offers many opportunities that add to overall career development. The candidate will continually collaborate with Global Communications and Marketing colleagues and connect across our business unit portfolio in networking, hybrid cloud, and AI to drive the implementation of 360-degree communications plans tied to HPE’s Enterprise Thought Leadership Program activations. The candidate will help support thought leadership activations, including by evaluating potential media partnerships, planning and budgeting for future sponsorships, coordinating messaging amplification strategies, event execution, and measuring and reporting on impacts and outcomes.

You’ll help us coordinate multiple elements of each thought leadership activation, centering on a 360 communications plan that relies heavily on internal alignment to engage executive stakeholders and manage media partners. You’ll do well in this role if you are a strategic thinker who is used to creating rigorous alignment agendas.

Responsibilities:
- Lead program management aspects of our thought leadership activations
- Manage execution with media partners, from planning and engagement to on-site execution and post-event follow-through—ensuring each moment is purposeful, differentiated, and maximizes targets for amplification and audience engagement
- Drive 360-degree communications plans and amplification strategies that extend thought leadership across paid, earned, owned, and social channels to maximize HPE’s thought leadership activations with “beyond the moment” elements
- Ensure each activation incorporates a go-to-market emphasis with customers and prospective customers by partnering with Global Marketing and Global Sales representatives
- Lead budgeting aspects of the program, including evaluating sponsorship packages against return on investment targets, and tracking future partnership opportunities
- Measure the impact of each thought leadership activation, helping define and track success across reach, engagement, influence, and pipeline outcomes, building a framework for thought leadership metrics.
- Support collaboration efforts with executive communications leaders in Global Communications to identify and prepare executive speakers for thought leadership moments
- Assist in managing new and existing media partner relationships on an ongoing basis

- Onboard new partners to the program, partnering with HPE Finance and HPE Procurement

What you bring:
- A strategic mindset with the ability to connect big ideas to business impact
- Experience in B2B technology, communications, or marketing with a strong understanding of importance of amplification across diverse business-oriented audiences
- Strength in partnering with colleagues across business units to support the development of thought leadership activations, amplified across channels
- A collaborative approach, with the ability to partner across highly matrixed teams
- A bias for action—balancing strategy with hands-on execution to maximize impact

Education and Experience Required:
- BA or BS in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, Business Administration, Public Relations, English, Political Science, International Relations, or other Liberal Arts disciplines.
- 7+ years of experience in corporate communications, media relations, team member communications, program management, or marketing.
- Previous program management and/or project management experience

Knowledge and Skills:
- Strong organization and program management skills.
- Advanced writing and editing skills - very minimal peer or manager edits needed.
- Proficiency in presentation development.
- Strong listening and interpersonal skills.
- Advanced knowledge and understanding of communications methodologies, tools and vehicles.
- Proven experience managing, leading, driving teams toward a common goal.
- High levels of tact and diplomacy.
- Agency and budget management.

- Preference for candidate based in the greater Houston, Texas area.

You will operate in a fast-paced, highly visible environment where your ability to bring structure, clarity, and execution discipline will directly influence business outcomes and resilience.

This is a senior individual contributor (IC) role within the Office of the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) Transformation Office, offering a highly visible opportunity to lead the delivery of complex, enterprise-wide cybersecurity programmes. You will report into the Director of the Transformation office and operate at the centre of Cybersecurity, IT, and business teams, driving critical initiatives that enable the organisation to scale securely and deliver on its strategic priorities. The role plays a key part in bringing structure, pace, and execution discipline to large, cross-functional programmes, ensuring commitments are met and outcomes are delivered. Combining deep programme leadership with strong stakeholder alignment, this position operates across both technical and business domains and offers the opportunity to directly shape how cybersecurity transformation is executed at scale.

Key Responsibilities
Program Delivery & Execution
- Lead delivery of complex cybersecurity programmes across multiple workstreams, ensuring alignment to enterprise priorities.
- Develop and manage integrated program plans, including milestones, dependencies, and critical path.
- Drive recovery plans ( “go-to-green” plans ) for at-risk initiatives, ensuring clear timelines and leadership visibility.
- Maintain strong execution discipline, ensuring predictable and high-quality delivery.

Enterprise Program Delivery
- Lead delivery of strategic cybersecurity initiatives across a range of domains, including enterprise platforms, risk management, and regulatory programmes where required.
- Support delivery of Cybersecurity Priorities like  Vulnerability Management, End Point Security, SailPoint, CyberArk rollouts as part of the broader portfolio.
- Contribute to regulatory and audit readiness programs (e.g., SOC 2 – System and Organization Controls 2 compliance ) where part of wider transformation efforts.
- Coordinate implementation of cross-functional initiatives, ensuring alignment across technical and business teams.

Execution Management & Coordination
- Manage dependencies, risks, and alignment across Cybersecurity, IT, and business stakeholders.
- Track and drive accountability across delivery teams and partners.
- Ensure clarity of ownership and alignment across shared initiatives.

Reporting & Governance
- Define and operationalize OKRs, KPIs, and executive reporting.
- Produce concise, decision-oriented updates for senior leadership.
- Maintain accurate programme dashboards, including milestones, delivery status, risks, and performance metrics.
- Replace internal-only reporting formats with clear, standard executive reporting formats.
- Improve transparency and quality of program reporting.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management
- Implement structured tracking of program risks, issues, dependencies, and actions ( RAID – Risks, Actions, Issues, Dependencies ).
- Proactively identify and resolve systemic blockers impacting delivery.
- Ensure clear ownership and timely resolution of programme risks and issues.

Cross-Functional Leadership
- Align Cybersecurity, IT, and business stakeholders on priorities, ownership, and execution approach.
- Act as a central coordination point across multi-team, enterprise initiatives.
- Build strong relationships to enable effective collaboration and decision-making.

Qualifications

Job Description:

HPE GreenLake Marketplace | Hybrid Cloud Strategy and Operations
Role Overview
HPE is seeking a strategic, execution-oriented Marketplace Program Manager to lead the expansion of HPE GreenLake Marketplace commerce beyond the United States. This role will translate country-level regulatory, tax, payment, identity, privacy, trade-compliance, contracting, localization, and operational requirements into a scalable market-entry program.
The program manager will coordinate phased launches across selected markets, preserving a consistent customer and seller experience while adapting the marketplace operating model to local requirements. The role will bring together Legal, Tax, Finance, Treasury, Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Partner Management, and external providers to deliver compliant, commercially viable launches.
What You Will Do
- Own the end-to-end geographic expansion roadmap, including market prioritization, business cases, sequencing, launch criteria, dependencies, resources, and executive decisions.
- Establish a repeatable country-readiness framework covering marketplace regulation, merchant-of-record structure, payment flows, indirect tax, invoicing, customer and seller identity verification, data protection, export controls, contracting, and local operating requirements.
- Lead cross-functional workstreams across Legal, Tax, Finance, Treasury, Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Partner Management, Customer Support, and regional teams.
- Evaluate market attractiveness and complexity; recommend launch waves based on customer opportunity, partner readiness, regulatory feasibility, cost, operational effort, and time to value.
- Translate external counsel and subject-matter-expert guidance into clear business requirements, control frameworks, decision logs, and executable plans.
- Define requirements for local currency, foreign exchange, tax calculation and remittance, invoicing, refunds, chargebacks, seller payouts, reconciliation, revenue recognition, and financial reporting.
- Partner with product and engineering teams to address customer identity, purchase eligibility, localization, data integration, and country-specific platform capabilities.
- Coordinate customer, independent software vendor, and channel-partner readiness, including onboarding, contracting, communications, training, support, and operational handoffs.
- Build integrated plans, RACIs, risk registers, dependency maps, budgets, and executive dashboards; proactively remove blockers and escalate decisions.
- Define launch and post-launch KPIs, conduct readiness reviews and retrospectives, and convert lessons learned into scalable playbooks for subsequent markets.
- Serve as the central point of accountability for geo-expansion status, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes from working-team through executive levels.

Key Deliverables
- Prioritized multi-phased country expansion strategy and launch roadmap.
- Country-readiness scorecards, market-entry recommendations, and approved business cases.
- Documented operating model, governance structure, controls, and cross-functional RACI.
- Country-specific product and process requirements with accountable owners and delivery milestones.
- Executive-ready reporting on schedule, budget, risks, decisions, and realized business impact.
- Reusable launch playbook that reduces cost, risk, and cycle time for each successive market.

About You
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, finance, operations, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- 6+ years of experience in program management, business operations, product operations, strategy, or related roles, including ownership of complex global initiatives.
- Demonstrated success leading multi-country launches or market-entry programs in a highly matrixed technology organization.
- Working knowledge of digital commerce or cloud marketplace operating models, including payments, tax, invoicing, seller settlement, and order-to-cash processes.
- Experience partnering with Legal, Tax, Finance, Product, Engineering, and regional business teams to convert policy or regulatory guidance into operating requirements.
- Strong program architecture skills, including roadmap development, governance, dependency management, risk management, budgeting, and executive reporting.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex issues and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
- Analytical judgment and comfort making recommendations amid ambiguity, incomplete information, and competing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with B2B software marketplaces, marketplace-as-a-service platforms, hyperscaler marketplaces, or global digital commerce.
- Familiarity with marketplace regulatory frameworks, VAT/GST, payment-services boundaries, merchant-of-record models, privacy, export controls, and enterprise identity verification.
- Experience working with payment processors, marketplace-platform providers, outside counsel, and multinational finance or tax teams.
- MBA or advanced degree in a relevant discipline.
- PMP, PgMP, Agile, or comparable program-management certification.

Job Description:

The WW Logistics and Fulfillment Organization is responsible for the delivery and fulfillment of customer orders on a global basis.

The Asia Logistics Manager shall be responsible for oversight of the Distribution and Logistics into and out of Asia.   The logistics operation, as managed by the designed HPE third party logistics provider (3PL), will support order fulfillment for both configured and build to order products Worldwide.

This position shall ensure that HPE’s 3PLs have established processes in place to meet the following requirements for the management sufficient capacity and throughput to support peak and end of quarter periods.
Will work in a collaborative way with several other cross-functional disciplines such as Legal and Compliance, Tax, Sales, Revenue, IT, and other functional and logistics teams (process owners) to bring process management acumen and discipline to the company, and coordinate efforts across the business. This position will report into the Director of WWOPS Logistics.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS
- Should possess at least 10 years’ experience in progressively more responsible leadership positions in areas of Logistics operations, Logistics Program management, Supply Planning & Trade Compliance.
- Should display an in-depth knowledge of both Logistics operations, strategy, inventory planning and Asia Trade Compliance processes including but not limited to understanding Monitor and Deliver Order Shipments across a Regional footprint.
-Reconcile and Manage Returns/Stock Rotation, Merge in Transit, Perform Compliance Checks, Generate Trade Documents and SOX compliance revenue recognition practices
-Understand the capabilities of Global / Regional Freight Forwarding Providers as well as Fulfillment Hub Providers. Knowledge in areas of logistics planning/analytics would be helpful.
- Experience managing key projects that are cross-functional
- Successful candidates should possess a proven ability to effectively communicate with cross-functional teams and objectively present pros and cons of alternatives. Be capable to assess and providing guidance on reducing risks of various alternatives.
- Extensive knowledge of process management tools, Six Sigma, metrics, and performance measurement techniques.  The ideal candidate knows how to employ these tools and processes effectively incorporating metrics by which progress against plan can be measured.
- Demonstrated successful experience in assessing process requirements, process development and implementation, and process maintenance.
- Must be able to think strategically and plan effectively; yet possess a detail-oriented, hands-on approach.  Must be results-oriented and ability to operate with a high sense of urgency.
- Demonstrated ability of establishing large distribution / fulfillment centers
- Reasonable amount of travel related to work responsibility is required.
- Multiple Languages preferred
- Knowledge of CM business in Asia

Key Responsibilities:
- Provide managerial oversight for a large DC and cross dock, as operated by HPE’s designed 3PL.  Prepare, manage, and monitor labor, capacity and DC/cross dock throughput.
- -Work closely with various internal business/process owners, within logistics as well as with Sales, Order Management, Revenue, Planning, Tax and Compliance etc.   Develop and implement a plan (roadmap) to achieve objectives for each of these processes.
- Align with and leverage third party system integration partners and consultants to plan and implement agreed programs
- Manage project timelines.  Be able to establish priorities, make business trade-offs, and sequence initiatives necessary to achieve long term process goals.  Ensure the integration of initiatives is completely consistent with the company's and WWOPS functional strategic goals and objectives.
- Coordinate with functional organizations to determine key linkage between cross-functional processes.  Proactively monitor and manage their linkage.
- Create by collaboration with the process owners, business case documents supporting project initiatives including business cases, ROIs, project functional scopes and specifications.
- Proactively and continuously identify business areas where improvements can be made to streamline workflow and application flow resulting in measurable savings of time, effort and costs.
- Constantly monitors industry for best practices in the Logistics and Trade Compliance functional business areas to leverage in business processes, driving improvements in workflow and applications.

Participates in the process by which demand signals are developed, validated for alignment with transition plans, supply constraints identified, and an executable plan defined that meets financial and market share goals. Ability to work with Senior leadership team to provide business intelligence and co-ordinate activities as chief of staff

- Leads a broad range of complex supply chain processes, such as inventory analysis and planning, demand planning, import/export operations, and sales and operations planning (SOP).
- Identifies opportunities for process improvement and leads/develops recommendations and provides insight for management.
- Independently executes complex demand and supply matching activities, connecting planning to execution, and identifying issues and their impact.
- Works cross-functionally to prioritize backlog.
- Partners with global business units and supply bases to generate and deliver demand signals.
- Leads cross-functional regional and global business unit planning teams to maintain and enhance the current business processes.
- Defines and reviews performance metrics on a regular basis, identifying opportunities for improvement actions to address.
- Contributes to priority projects by adding creative insights and developing recommendations.
- Communicates requirements and guidelines to the regional and global business unit planning teams.
- Mentors junior-level staff and establishes guidelines for the mentorship programs.
- Leads and manages a Regulatory Trade Compliance program.

Education and Experience Required:
- First level university degree or equivalent experience; advanced university degree preferred.
- Typically 6-10 years of experience in a supply chain function.
- Experience in more than one supply chain function.
- Broker's license and/or 6-10 years of experience in a customs/global trade function.

Knowledge and Skills:
- Excellent understanding of supply chain processes (plan, source, make deliver).
- Identifies cutting edge analytical tools, models and methods for making key business decisions.
- Excellent communication and influencing skills; mastery in English and local language.
- Excellent internal and external relationship management skills.
- Extensive knowledge and understanding of how to analyze business problems using Advanced Microsoft Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint, etc.), statistical analysis, and financial modeling.
- Very Strong project management skills, with capability to manage cross functional teams in multiple geographies.
- Strong business acumen and technical knowledge within area of responsibility.
- Very strong understanding of the company's overall supply chain strategy.
- Excellent understanding of Material Requirements Planning (MRP), ATP and master scheduling.
- Excellent understanding of national and international trade requirements to align customs/trade function with business objectives.
- Thorough knowledge of inventory modeling and analysis.
- Strong leadership skills including team-building and conflict resolution and management.
- Excellent understanding in developing and managing a trade compliance program.

Job Description:

Senior Certification Program Manager
Location: US Remote Worker
Hybrid worker if within 50 miles of HPE Site

About the Role
We are seeking a Certification Program Manager to support the planning, development, launch, maintenance, and retirement of professional certification programs. This role will manage certification operations, vendor relationships, program schedules, and cross-functional activities to support consistent program delivery and candidate experience.
The position works closely with internal stakeholders, subject matter experts, testing providers, certification platforms, and other external partners to execute certification programs in alignment with business and program requirements.

Key Responsibilities
Certification Program Management
- Manage certification programs throughout the lifecycle, including planning, development, launch, maintenance, recertification, and retirement.
- Develop and maintain certification roadmaps, release schedules, project plans, and operational processes.
- Coordinate certification activities across internal teams, subject matter experts, and external service providers.
- Monitor program milestones, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and operational performance.
- Identify and implement process improvements to support program efficiency and consistency.
- Partner with stakeholders to align certification programs with product, business, and market requirements.

Vendor and Partner Management
- Manage relationships with vendors supporting certification development, exam delivery, psychometrics, certification platforms, digital credentials, localization, and content development.
- Manage vendor contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), budgets, service-level agreements (SLAs), deliverables, and performance metrics.
- Coordinate activities across multiple vendors to support project timelines, quality requirements, and program objectives.
- Track vendor performance and address operational issues, risks, and escalations as needed.

Certification Operations
- Oversee certification management systems, credentialing platforms, and related operational processes.
- Ensure certification requirements, policies, and program updates are accurately implemented across applicable systems and processes.
- Support certification launches, updates, recertification programs, and program changes.
- Maintain operational documentation, procedures, and process requirements.
- Support audits, appeals, exception requests, and certification policy inquiries.

Candidate Support
- Serve as an escalation point for candidate inquiries related to exam registration, scheduling, testing accommodations, score reporting, certification status, digital credentials, recertification, and program policies.
- Coordinate with testing providers, certification platforms, and internal support teams to investigate and resolve candidate issues.
- Monitor candidate support trends and identify opportunities to improve processes and the candidate experience.
- Develop and maintain candidate-facing procedures, FAQs, and other support documentation.
- Ensure candidate support processes are aligned with applicable certification policies and accessibility requirements.
- Analyze candidate feedback and operational data to identify opportunities for process improvements.

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Education, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
- 5+ years of experience in certification operations, credentialing programs, technical training, learning program management, or a related field.
- Experience working with certification tools and testing providers, preferably Pearson VUE, Credly and Alpine Cert Metrics.
- Experience managing external vendors or service providers.
- Experience managing multiple projects, programs, or operational initiatives.
- Experience coordinating activities across cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
- Experience developing and maintaining project plans, schedules, processes, and documentation.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
- Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and project or program management tools.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience supporting IT, networking, cloud, cybersecurity, or other technical certification programs.
- Familiarity with exam development processes, psychometrics, or certification industry practices.
- Experience managing vendor contracts, SOWs, budgets, and service agreements.
- PMP, Agile, Scrum, or related project management certification.

Core Competencies
- Certification Program Management
- Vendor and Partner Management
- Program and Project Management
- Certification Operations
- Lifecycle and Release Management
- Stakeholder Coordination
- Process Improvement
- Risk and Issue Management
- Candidate Support Operations
- Budget and Resource Management

Job Description:

We are seeking a strategic Functional Architect to serve as the primary bridge between Product Management, Business Stakeholders, and IT. This role is responsible for leading the functional design and roadmap that enables New Product Introduction (NPI) and complex Quote to Cash strategies across our Go-To-Market systems, including Salesforce CRM, Oracle CPQ, and SAP ERP.

Overview:
The ideal candidate will move beyond standard process maintenance to proactively influence how new products, software-as-a-service (SaaS) offerings, and hardware bundles are structured and sold. You will ensure that as Product Management innovates, our "Quote to Cash" ecosystem is designed to support rapid launches, scalable growth, and a seamless seller experience.

Responsibilities:
- NPI Strategy & Execution:  Act as the lead Sales Ops consultant for Product Management during the NPI process. Influence product modeling and SKU health to ensure new offerings are compatible with our CPQ and ERP architecture.

- Commercialization Partnership:  Partner closely with Product Management and Marketing to translate commercial requirements (configuration modeling, subscription terms, bundling logic) into scalable functional designs.

- Architectural Roadmapping:  Orchestrate cross-functional collaboration to deliver short-term and long-term roadmaps that align our GTM technology with the evolving product portfolio and the "Future of Selling" vision.

- Technical Documentation:  Develop end-to-end process artifacts, including Business Requirements Documents (BRD) for new product launches, logic flow charts for CPQ configuration, and solution designs for automated fulfillment.

- Launch Readiness & Change Management:  Lead the rollout of new product capabilities within the sales tools, providing training and change management to ensure Sales and System Engineering teams can effectively quote and sell new offerings

Education and Experience Required:
- 5+ years of experience in designing and implementing business processes and solutions.

Job Description:

Cloud Commit Channel Program Manager

Hybrid Cloud Strategy and Operations
Role Overview
The Cloud Commit Channel and Distribution Program Manager will lead the strategic expansion, design, launch, and scaled operation of HPE Cloud Commit across indirect routes to market. Cloud Commit is a multi-year spend commitment program through which customers receive contractual incentives, including preferential pricing, procurement efficiency, and purchasing flexibility across eligible software, infrastructure, and services in the Hybrid Cloud portfolio.
This role will design and operationalize the commercial model required for distributors and resellers.  Building on the program’s existing structure, this role will lead the effort to maintain the core program principles, extending the value proposition and execution of program into the channel.
The role will define how responsibilities, economics, data, and transactions flow across HPE, partners, and end customers in one-tier and two-tier models. This includes determining the appropriate commitment-holder and contracting model, partner eligibility, discount application, quoting and ordering processes, invoiced-spend attribution, reporting, reconciliation, governance, and issue resolution.
The successful candidate will combine strategic program leadership with hands-on execution, converting ambiguous business challenges into clear decisions, scalable processes, measurable requirements, partner-tested workflows, and launch-ready capabilities across countries and partner segments.
Key Responsibilities
- Own the strategy, roadmap, design, launch, and ongoing optimization of the Cloud Commit channel and distribution program across priority countries and partner segments.
- Define scalable one-tier and two-tier routes to market for distributors, resellers, cloud service providers, managed service providers, and other eligible channel partners.
- Translate Cloud Commit’s multi-year spend, catalog, pricing, reporting, shortfall, and renewal constructs into clear partner-facing commercial and operating models.
- Lead the cross-functional core team in defining program requirements, including eligibility, contracting, discount application, quoting, ordering, invoicing, reporting, renewals, and shortfall management.
- Establish clear accountability across HPE, distributors, resellers, partners, and end customers for pricing, transaction execution, spend reporting, reconciliation, and issue resolution.
- Partner with finance, legal, tax, pricing, controllership, sales operations, IT, product management, and channel organizations to identify dependencies, resolve operational gaps, and drive timely decisions.
- Drive requirements for channel dashboards and reporting that provide appropriate aggregated, partner-level, and customer-level views of commitments, eligible spend, attainment, remaining balance, forecast, and risk alerts.
- Build program playbooks, standard operating procedures, governance forums, decision rights, escalation paths, and launch-readiness criteria.
- Engage distributors and strategic partners to validate assumptions, test workflows, identify constraints, and execute pilots with clear selection, entry, exit, adoption, and change-management criteria. Use partner feedback and transaction data to refine the model before broader scale.
- Design field and partner enablement, including value propositions, qualification guidance, sales plays, process training, FAQs, and role-based communications.
- Track program performance and provide executive-ready scorecards covering pipeline, commitments, revenue, partner participation, cycle time, forecast accuracy, spend attainment, and operational health.
- Represent the program in senior leadership reviews, partner meetings, and regional operating forums.

Measures of Success
- An approved channel and distribution commercial and operating model launched in priority markets.
- Clear, repeatable end-to-end partner workflows from opportunity identification through commitment tracking, issue resolution, and renewal.
- Improved conversion of channel-led opportunities into Cloud Commit agreements.
- Accurate and timely reporting of eligible spend, attainment, forecasts, and risks across channel transactions.
- Reduced transaction friction, pricing exceptions, manual reconciliation, and escalations.
- Strong partner adoption, field readiness, and satisfaction with the program experience.
- Measurable committed revenue, pipeline growth, and incremental Hybrid Cloud portfolio consumption.

Required Qualifications

Identifies and implements scalable global processes and operating models that improve efficiency, consistency, quality and business performance while addressing essential regional requirements.

The role comes with recognized authority in global service-delivery transformation, continuous improvement, process optimization and operational excellence. Defines strategy, operating mechanisms and standardized processes that can be implemented consistently across AMS, EMEA, LATAM and APJ while accommodating essential regional or regulatory requirements. Leads large, complex, cross-functional and cross-regional programs that influence long-term organizational objectives, operational efficiency, service quality and scalability. Develops innovative approaches, establishes functional direction and exercises independent judgment in complex and ambiguous global environments. Influences senior and executive stakeholders across regions, facilitates agreement on global standards, and guides cross-functional teams and program or project leaders without direct people-management responsibility as the primary job function.

- Orchestrate cross-functional delivery. Coordinate resources across countries, regions and functions, establish accountability and sustain delivery across multiple concurrent initiatives.
- Global remit across AMS, EMEA, LATAM and APJ, affecting multiple countries, functions and Service Delivery teams.
- Drives measurable, sustainable improvements in efficiency, consistency, quality, cost effectiveness and scalability through global processes and operating standards.
- Programs may have significant business or financial impact and require disciplined benefit tracking, executive governance and long-term organizational commitment.
- Operates within highly complex global environments where regional priorities, existing processes, customer requirements, regulatory considerations and global standardization objectives must be reconciled.
- Leads initiatives involving multiple regions, organizations and functions, often with interconnected projects and competing priorities.
- Must be capable of analyzing different regional ways of working and determining what can and should be standardized globally.

The secure, AI-native network is not just a vision—it is our mission.
Juniper Networks is now part of HPE—creating the industry's first secure, AI-native network, purpose-built with AI and for AI to deliver the best experiences across enterprises, service providers, and cloud operators.
HPE Networking  is bringing together unparalleled products and talent, bolstered by a long heritage in both networking and AI.

Role & Responsibilities
The Business Development Lead will drive the Public Sector business development strategy for the HPE Networking portfolio in Germany. This is a market-shaping role focused on creating the conditions for future sales success by translating political, regulatory, and funding developments into tangible business opportunities and strategic growth initiatives. The role operates upstream of the sales cycle and works closely with sales, partners, consultants, government stakeholders, and industry bodies.
Market Development, Public Policy & Regulatory Alignment
- Monitor and assess key public-sector initiatives, regulations, and digital transformation programs impacting networking and infrastructure investments.
- Translate political and regulatory drivers into customer requirements related to network infrastructure, cybersecurity, Zero Trust architectures, segmentation, sovereign IT, operating models, and data governance.

- Collaborate closely with Government Relations and Public Affairs teams by providing subject matter expertise and market insights.

Industry Representation & Ecosystem Engagement

- Represent the company in selected industry bodies and professional forums through active participation, presentations, and thought leadership activities.
- Coordinate internal engagement across committees and industry organizations to ensure aligned messaging and strategic positioning.

- Build trusted relationships with key public-sector influencers and decision-making communities.

Funding Programs & Strategic Market Initiatives
- Establish and maintain visibility into federal, state, and EU funding programs relevant to networking and digital infrastructure.
- Assess the eligibility of portfolio solutions within public funding frameworks and develop supporting business cases and compliance documentation.
- Track funding cycles, application windows, and budget allocations to support market planning and opportunity development.
- Create reusable frameworks, reference architectures, and value propositions aligned with key funding initiatives.

Consultant & Advisor Ecosystem Development
- Identify, segment, and build relationships with planners, engineering firms, public-sector consultants, technical advisors, and leading management consultancies.
- Develop structured enablement programs including workshops, training sessions, planning documentation, reference architectures, and tender support materials.
- Engage early in customer planning processes to ensure portfolio capabilities are reflected in technology requirements and procurement specifications.
- Provide procurement-compliant, vendor-neutral technical specifications and guidance.

Opportunity Development & Business Growth
- Convert identified market opportunities into qualified sales opportunities and hand them over to appropriate account teams with stakeholder, timing, and market intelligence.
- Support strategically important tenders and initial projects in emerging market segments.
- Build customer references, success stories, and repeatable blueprints for future engagements.
- Collaborate closely with sales, presales, channel, marketing, legal, compliance, and regional stakeholders to accelerate market adoption.
- This role does not carry direct deal ownership or forecast responsibility.

Focus Areas
Key target segments include:
- Federal Government Agencies
- State Government Authorities
- Statutory Health Insurance Organizations
- University Hospitals and Healthcare Networks

If you are…
- Good at partnering, innovating, and making things happen? Good start, you are aligned to our core values !

- Minimum 5 years of experience within the German Public Sector in Sales, Business Development, Consulting, or a related field.
- Established professional network across at least two of the target public-sector segments.
- Strong understanding of German public procurement procedures, tender processes, framework agreements, and procurement regulations.
- Solid knowledge of networking and infrastructure technologies, with the ability to engage credibly with planners, consultants, architects, and technical stakeholders.
- Experience working with industry associations, committees, working groups, or similar stakeholder organizations.

- Willingness to travel extensively within Germany.

- Experience with public funding programs, grant mechanisms, and associated compliance requirements.
- Experience leading cross-functional initiatives or providing informal leadership.
- Understanding of planning and specification processes in public-sector projects.
- Existing security clearance or willingness to undergo a security screening process.
- Experience working with digital transformation, cybersecurity, critical infrastructure, healthcare, or government modernization initiatives.

Job Description:

Manager II, Semiconductor Supply Planning & Procurement
About the Position
Are you an experienced people leader who can bring together semiconductor commodity strategy, supply planning, procurement execution, and operational excellence to ensure critical components are available when and where they are needed?
We are seeking a highly analytical and results-driven Manager II, Semiconductor Supply Planning & Procurement to build, develop, and lead a team of commodity procurement managers and a buy-sell procurement operations manager supporting HPE Networking sustaining products.
The team is responsible for managing the supply of critical semiconductor and memory components, including memory, CPUs, FPGAs, silicon, wireless, and other electronic components. Responsibilities span component forecasting and planning, supplier engagement, procurement execution, inventory management, allocation management, and supply risk mitigation.
In this role, you will provide leadership, direction, and operational governance across the component portfolio. You will establish priorities, balance resources, standardize processes, and ensure the team delivers consistent results that support customer commitments and business objectives. You will be accountable for overall component supply health, inventory performance, forecasting effectiveness, procurement execution, and continuity of supply.
You will collaborate closely with suppliers, distributors, inventory hubs, ODM/CM partners, engineering, planning, procurement, finance, and operations teams. The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with deep semiconductor supply chain expertise, operational discipline, business acumen, and the ability to communicate complex supply situations to senior leaders.
Key Responsibilities
Team Leadership
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of commodity procurement managers and procurement operations professionals.
- Balance resources and priorities across commodities to ensure business objectives are met.
- Establish team priorities, goals, performance expectations, and accountability measures.
- Foster a culture of collaboration, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
- Support employee development, succession planning, and capability building.

Supply Planning & Forecasting Management
- Own overall supply health across semiconductor and memory commodities.

Job Description

HPE’s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company’s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build HPE Networking, with the ambition of creating the best networking business on the planet. This role sits at the center of that effort as part of the Lead-to-Cash (L2C) program, responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a single platform, replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.

As part of a fast-moving, multi-year transformation, the team will stabilize near-term operations, migrate core platforms, onboard   businesses   and suppliers globally, and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business   operates   for years to come. You will work closely with business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever   attempt .

For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help build a new business unit from its earliest days, rather than inherit someone else’s systems. You will gain hands-on exposure to enterprise-scale platform integration and cross-functional program leadership, with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. If you want your work to have a visible impact on a company making a significant investment in its future, this is where that happens.

Workstream-Specific Details

The Supplier Onboarding Lead   is responsible for   orchestrating the onboarding of manufacturing suppliers and trading partners to HPE’s supply chain network. This role requires deep   expertise   in high-tech manufacturing processes, supply chain management, and SAP S/4HANA integration. The candidate will enable seamless B2B transactions through industry-standard protocols such as EDI, XML, APIs, ensuring partners meet HPE’s operational and compliance standards. Typical transactions may include purchase orders, order acknowledgments, advance ship notices, invoices, inventory updates, and other supply-chain documents. EDI-to-SAP integration commonly supports automated processing of purchase orders, shipping notices, invoices, and acknowledgments while   maintaining   data integrity and business-rule validation. This role is key to HPE's digital transformation initiatives in supplier management and autonomous supply chain operations.

Responsibilities

- Lead the onboarding process for manufacturing partners, ensuring alignment with HPE’s global supply chain strategies and quality standards.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Supply Chain Operations, Manufacturing, IT,   finance   and Business Development to gather requirements and   facilitate   onboarding.

- Manage end-to-end integration setup, focusing on enabling B2B transactions via EDI, XML,   APIs   and other industry standards, leveraging HPE’s integration frameworks.

- Gather and document business requirements for B2B transactions, including purchase orders, order acknowledgments, advance ship notices, invoices, inventory transactions, and master-data exchanges.

- Ensure integrations align with SAP S/4HANA business processes, relevant SAP modules, SAP IDocs, APIs, and approved integration architecture.

- Deploy and oversee agentic AI systems that autonomously manage supplier assessments, intelligent issue resolution, and dynamic workflow adaptation.

- Develop comprehensive onboarding documentation, integration configurations,   playbook   and process workflows aligned with HPE’s standards.

- Ensure compliance with HPE’s security, data privacy, and operational policies throughout the onboarding lifecycle.

- Drive continuous improvement in onboarding processes,   leveraging   industry best   practices   and HPE’s digital transformation initiatives.

- Act as a subject matter expert on supply chain and manufacturing technology, providing guidance and support to partners and internal teams.

- Monitor onboarding progress, resolve issues proactively, and   report on   key metrics to stakeholders. Enable autonomous supplier data validation, compliance verification, and quality standard assessment through agentic AI workflows.

- Identify   opportunities for process improvements using AI-generated insights, process mining analytics, and agentic recommendations.

Education And Experience Required

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management , Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field. Master's degree preferred.

- Minimum 8-10 years of progressive experience in supply chain operations, procurement, or manufacturing within the high-tech industry (IT hardware, electronics manufacturing preferred).

- Minimum 3-5 years of hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA, including configuration, implementation, or support roles in supply chain modules (MM, SD, LE).

- Minimum   5+ years of experience designing, implementing, and managing B2B integration solutions in enterprise environments.

- Experience with solutions in SAP for order fulfillment/Supply chain function.

- Experience in Logistics execution: Shipping (Delivery processing, Picking, Packing, Goods Issue, Printing and Communication in Shipping), Scheduling, Outbound Delivery, Stock Transport Orders (STO), Shipment Processing and Route Determination.

- Demonstrated experience leading supplier onboarding, vendor management, or partner enablement programs in global organizations.

- Prior experience working with contract manufacturers (CMs) in high-tech sectors.

- Experience with enterprise integration platforms and middleware solutions (e.g.,   WebMethods , Seeburger, SAP PI/PO, or similar).

- Proven   track record   of managing complex cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and tight timelines.

Knowledge And Skills:

Technical Knowledge:

- Expert-level knowledge of EDI standards (ANSI X.12, EDIFACT) and XML-based B2B protocols

- Deep understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, particularly supply chain and   logistics   modules (MM, SD, LE, GR/IR processes).

- Proficiency   in integration technologies including APIs, web services, and middleware platforms.

- Knowledge of supply chain data models, master data management (MDM), and data governance best practices.

- Familiarity with EDI mapping tools, integration testing methodologies, and troubleshooting techniques.

- Understanding of   cybersecurity and data privacy standards relevant to B2B transactions (e.g., encryption, secure file transfer protocols).

AI, Automation, and Agentic AI Knowledge:

- Working knowledge of AI-driven data validation and quality assurance tools.

- Understanding of   agentic AI frameworks and concepts, including autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, and agent orchestration.

Business Knowledge:

- Comprehensive understanding of high-tech manufacturing operations, including supply chain planning, procurement, and   logistics .

- Understanding of   global trade regulations, tariffs, and customs compliance.

Soft Skills:

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with   ability   to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

- Strong project management and organizational skills with   ability   to manage multiple onboarding initiatives simultaneously.

- Problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail.

As the primary owner of component supply execution, you will work closely with commodity managers, suppliers, distributors, inventory hubs, procurement teams, planners, ODM/CM partners, and operations teams to proactively resolve shortages, mitigate risks, and maintain continuity of supply.
