Job Description
HPE’s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company’s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build   HPE Networking , with the ambition of creating the   best networking business on the planet . This role sits at the center of that effort as part of   the Lead-to-Cash (L2C) program , responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a   single platform , replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.

As part of a fast-moving,   multi-year transformation , the team will stabilize near-term operations,   migrate core   platforms, onboard   businesses   and suppliers globally , and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business   operates   for years to come. You will work closely with   business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders   on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever   attempt .

For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help   build a new business unit from its earliest days , rather than inherit someone else’s systems. You will gain   hands-on exposure to enterprise-scale platform integration and cross-functional program leadership , with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. If you want your work to have a visible impact on a company making a significant investment in its future, this is where that happens.

Workstream-Specific Details

The Logistics Solutions Lead   is responsible for   developing and executing comprehensive   logistics   solutions and transformation strategies that   optimize   HPE's global supply chain operations. This role requires strategic   expertise   in supply chain management,   logistics   operations, warehouse management, carrier management, and B2B integration technologies. The candidate will lead   logistics   partner onboarding initiatives, design regional fulfillment models,   establish   integration standards compliance, and enable advanced   logistics   solutions across key areas including incoterms management, post-goods receipt/issue processes, proof of delivery, and end-to-end   logistics   visibility. This role is critical to HPE's   logistics   network resilience, operational

Responsibilities

- Lead the onboarding of carriers, 3PLs, freight forwarders, warehouses, and regional fulfillment partners from solution design through testing, go-live, and   hypercare .

- Own   logistics   solution design and enablement in SAP S/4HANA, including delivery processing, picking, packing, post goods issue, shipping output/printing, customer and carrier communication, scheduling, outbound delivery, Stock Transport Orders (STOs), shipment processing, and route determination.

-  Design regional fulfillment models that support service-level, inventory, cost, capacity, customer-promise, and compliance requirements.

-  Define and support processes aligned with Incoterms, transportation responsibility, title/risk transfer, customs requirements, and trade-compliance needs.

-  Lead carrier-management activities, including onboarding standards, routing guides, service-level agreements, performance reviews, capacity readiness, and operational escalation management.

- Translate business needs into process flows, functional specifications, integration requirements, test cases, and deployment plans.

- Enable B2B transactions using EDI, XML, APIs, IDocs, flat files, and related integration standards for orders, shipment status, inventory, labels, invoices, and warehouse communications.

-  Partner with SAP, integration, data, and external technology teams to define mappings, interface monitoring, acknowledgments, error handling, reconciliation, and production-support processes.

- Identify   opportunities to apply agentic automation and AI-enabled workflows to streamline partner onboarding,   validate   transaction data, triage integration failures, manage exceptions, generate operational documentation, and improve   logistics   decision-making.

- Establish operational dashboards and controls for interface health, transaction success rates, carrier performance, delivery status, fulfillment exceptions, and root-cause analysis.

- Lead cross-functional testing, including system integration testing, user acceptance testing, end-to-end partner testing, cutover readiness, and post-launch stabilization.

-  Create training materials and enable internal teams and external partners to   operate   new   logistics   processes effectively.

Education And Experience Required

- Bachelor’s degree in CS, IT, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered.

-  8+ years of experience in SAP solutions implementations in supply chain,   logistics , transportation, warehouse management, fulfillment, or   logistics   technology.

-  5+ years of experience leading   logistics   partner onboarding, carrier or 3PL implementations, transportation integration, or comparable   external-partner   enablement programs.

- Experience in Logistics execution: Shipping (Delivery processing, Picking, Packing, Goods Issue, Printing and Communication in Shipping), Scheduling, Outbound Delivery, Stock Transport Orders (STO), Shipment Processing and Route Determination.

- Experience in   high -tech industry with   complex   global   supply-chai n   environment.

- Hands-on SAP S/4HANA experience in logistics-related functions, such as SD, LE, MM, EWM, TM, shipping, warehouse, or transportation processes.

- Experience delivering B2B integrations using EDI, XML, APIs, IDocs, middleware, managed integration platforms, or similar technologies.

- Experience implementing automation, AI, workflow automation, intelligent document processing, or agentic solutions in   supply-chain ,   logistics ,   customer-service , or integration-support environments is strongly preferred.

- Experience with global shipping, Incoterms, trade compliance, customs processes, and regional fulfillment models is preferred.

Knowledge And Skills

- Strong knowledge of end-to-end   logistics , including transportation, carrier management, warehouse operations, order fulfillment, inventory visibility, and regional distribution networks.

- Deep SAP S/4HANA functional knowledge across delivery processing, outbound delivery, picking, packing, goods issue, shipping communication, scheduling, STOs, shipment processing, and route determination.

Job Description:

As the Technical Marketing Lead, HPE Cloud Software for Customer Enablement, you will be the primary technical authority responsible for the success of clients building on HPE’s software stack. You will lead the strategy for how customers architect, deploy, and operate high-scale Private and Sovereign Clouds using HPE Morpheus (Orchestration), HPE OpsRamp (Observability), and HPE Zerto (Data Protection).

This is a high-impact leadership role that requires a rare blend of "deep-in-the-weeds" technical expertise and you will sit at the intersection of cloud architecture, customer business models, and product execution, partnering deeply with Engineering, Sales, Alliances, and customers.

Primary Responsibilities
1. Strategic Customer Roadmap Alignment
- This role owns the technical product strategy that enables clients to build, own, and operate scalable, secure, and commercially viable clouds using HPE CloudOps Software virtualization stacks—spanning compute, networking, storage, lifecycle automation, observability, and multi-tenant operations.

- Executive Technical Interface: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for VPs of Engineering and CTOs at our clients.

2. Technical Architecture & Design
- Validated Designs (CVDs): Own the creation and maintenance of HPE Validated Designs specifically for customer use cases (e.g., "Sovereign Cloud-in-a-Box").|

- Reference Architectures: Define how HPE CloudOps software integrates with underlying hardware and third-party stacks e.g. OpenShift

3. Thought Leadership & Technical Collateral
- Content Engine: Author high-value technical white papers, reference guides, and deep-dive architectural blogs.

- Speaker & Evangelist: Represent HPE Cloud Ops at major industry events (e.g., , Advisory Boards, HPE Discover).

4. Technical Enablement & Operations
- Day 0 to Day 2 Success: Define the blueprints for how companies not only build their clouds but how they operate them profitably using AIOps and automated lifecycle management

- Sales Engineering Bridge: Act as the "Level 3" support for global field teams on complex, multi-product architectural bids.

Experience & Skills

1. Professional Background
- 10+ years in Technical Marketing and/or Systems Architecture.

- Prior Experience: Must have held a similar role at VMware, Red Hat, Nutanix, or a Hyperscaler (AWS/Azure/GCP) specifically focused on partner/service provider enablement.

2. Deep Technical Stack Expertise
- Virtualization: Deep knowledge of ESXi, KVM, and AHV.

- Cloud Native: Strong command of Kubernetes, OpenShift, and container networking/storage.

- Operations/Observability: Expertise in AIOps, distributed tracing, and multi-cloud monitoring.

- Data Protection: Understanding of RPO/RTO requirements for disaster recovery and cyber-resilience.

- Proven ability to lead through influence across a matrixed organization (Engineering, Marketing, and Sales).

Job Description:

HPE is seeking a Communications Manager, HR Communications . This is a hybrid role. Do you have exceptional communication skills and experience leading complex, high-visibility communications programs in a global, matrixed organization? Are you a strategic storyteller who can connect business priorities, innovation, leadership narratives, and team member engagement into compelling communications experiences? Do you thrive in environments where you can influence stakeholders, shape strategy, and drive measurable impact?

This is a rare opportunity to join HPE’s world-class Global Communications team. With more than 100 communicators across the globe, we advocate for HPE’s corporate strategy, business innovation, and thought leadership. We are seeking a strategic internal communications manager to help shape how HPE communicates some of its most important people priorities. From talent and performance initiatives to career and rewards programs, you'll build and execute compelling narratives and engaging communication experiences that resonate with team members around the world.

How you’ll make your mark:

As a member of the Team Member Communications team, you will serve as a strategic communications advisor to Human Resources to help shape how HPE communicates and amplifies the experiences that enable our people to do their best work, grow their careers, and thrive, including but not limited to career development, performance management, and benefits and rewards. You'll partner closely with HR leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to develop audience-based communication strategies, advise on messaging approaches, influence outcomes, and deliver campaigns to educate and inform both leaders and team members. Your work will help strengthen trust, drive engagement, and connect HPE's people strategy to our broader business ambitions. Success in this role requires equal parts strategist, storyteller, consultant, and executor.

In this role, you will:

- Support HR communications initiatives by translating people-related programs, policies, and priorities into clear, practical, and engaging messages for global audiences.
- Develop communication strategies for people leaders and team members that support HPE priorities across talent, performance, and rewards experiences.
- Draft, edit, and coordinate content for multiple internal channels, including email messages, intranet articles, talking points, presentations, social posts, and engagement materials.
- Serve as a trusted advisor to HR teams on communication best practices and strategies.
- Project manage with leadership oversight; lead communications timelines, reviews, and deliverables across stakeholders and program owners to ensure accurate, timely execution.
- Ensure all communications are clear, compelling, inclusive, and aligned with HPE’s writing style, brand standards, and tone.
- Use engagement data, feedback, and performance insights to refine communication approaches and strengthen team member engagement.

What we’re looking for:
- Exceptional writing, editing, storytelling, and executive communication skills.
- Ability to translate complex HR, business, and leadership topics into clear, simple, and actionable language for global audiences.
- Proven ability to lead complex, multi-stakeholder projects with independence and accountability.
- Consultative mindset, strong listening skills, and comfort asking questions to build understanding and strengthen outcomes.
- Creative thinking and willingness to experiment with new communication tactics, channels, and formats.
- Ability to handle sensitive information with integrity, discretion, and sound judgment.
- Strong program management, prioritization, and organizational skills.
- Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
- Positive, collaborative approach with the initiative to take ownership, contribute ideas, and ask for support when needed.

Qualifications:
- BA or BS in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
- Minimum of 7+ years of experience in internal communications, employee communications, HR communications, leadership communications, journalism, marketing communications, or a related field.
- Experience supporting HR, culture, or employee engagement communications is a plus.
- Proficient command of English (US), including excellent grammar, composition, editing, and proofreading skills.
- Familiarity with content management systems, collaboration tools, social media platforms, and basic multimedia or design tools is preferred.
- A portfolio of writing, editing, or communications work is preferred.

jobs.title: WW Hybrid Cloud Solutions Sales Leader
jobs.location: Spring, Texas, United States of America
jobs.description:
WW Hybrid Cloud Solutions Sales Leader

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

The Opportunity
Hybrid cloud is at the heart of HPE’s strategy. Customers want the cloud experience, cloud economics and as-a-service (AAS) flexibility, on-premises and under their control. HPE is uniquely positioned to deliver this through HPE GreenLake Flex Solutions and our Hybrid Cloud software and IP.
We are looking for a transformational sales leader to run the Worldwide Hybrid Cloud Solutions sales organization: around 500 sales and presales professionals, with more than $2B in orders. This is a rare chance to reshape how HPE sells hybrid cloud. You will move the business from selling consumption solutions to selling complete Hybrid Cloud solutions, spanning hybrid cloud operations software, sovereign cloud and private cloud, including private cloud for AI, and scale a software-attached, recurring-revenue motion across every geo.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead the transformation. Define and drive the multi-year transformation of the WW Hybrid Cloud Solutions sales motion, covering skills, coverage, sales plays, operating rhythm and culture, to accelerate AAS and software growth.

- Own the number. Deliver more than $2B in orders with profitable growth, and stay accountable for revenue, margin, pipeline creation and forecast across nine geos.

- Lead a global team at scale. Lead, develop and inspire around 500 sales and presales professionals through Geo HCS leaders. Build a high-performance culture, a strong bench and robust succession plans.

- Win with AAS. Drive the GreenLake Flex Solutions motion end to end: deal shaping, commercial and pricing models, contract structures and disciplined execution through CPQ and deal desk processes.

- Grow software. Ensure Geo teams own Software execution and forecast in their markets, working in close partnership with the WW Software leadership, which keeps worldwide Software accountability. Drive software attach and create new Software opportunities, including in net-new and hunting accounts.

- Orchestrate the matrix. Lead Geo tiger teams with Compute, Channel and other HPE businesses. Work in close alignment with the Business Units, Geo leadership, Partners, CSP and GSI teams to land large, complex hybrid cloud pursuits.

- Partner with Hybrid Cloud Operations. Work hand in hand with Hybrid Cloud Operations, a critical enabler of our transformation, to scale deal execution, commercial excellence and customer outcomes.

- Run the business with rigor. Set coverage models, quotas and goals. Drive pipeline discipline, accurate forecasting, productivity and a consistent operating cadence across geos.

- Be the executive face to customers. Build trusted C-level relationships with strategic customers and partners. Sponsor key pursuits and represent HPE Hybrid Cloud in the market.

- Shape the strategy. Act as a member of the WW Hybrid Cloud Sales leadership team. Bring the voice of the customer and the field into go-to-market, offer and investment decisions.

What Success Looks Like
- Sustained growth in orders, AAS (GreenLake Flex) and software, with healthy margins

- Strong pipeline creation, including new logos and software opportunities beyond the installed base

- Consistent, predictable execution and forecast across all nine geos

- A transformed, engaged sales organization with stronger skills, talent and leadership bench

What You Bring
- Proven transformation leader: a track record of leading large-scale sales transformations in complex, global, matrixed organizations.

- Global leadership at scale: 15+ years in enterprise technology, including significant experience leading international or worldwide sales and presales organizations of several hundred people, preferably in a specialist or overlay model.

- AAS and commercial acumen: a deep understanding of as-a-service, subscription and recurring-revenue business models, pricing and deal structuring. Experience selling AAS on-premises is a strong plus.

- Operational rigor: strong operational discipline across CPQ, deal desk, pipeline management, forecasting and sales operations.

- Hybrid cloud and software expertise: a solid grasp of hybrid cloud, infrastructure, data, AI and software. Experience with companies such as Nutanix, NetApp, Pure Storage, VMware/Broadcom, Dell or the hyperscalers is valued.

- Executive presence: credibility with C-level customers, partners and internal executives, and the ability to influence without direct authority.

- People leader: a record of attracting, developing and retaining top talent and building diverse, high-performing teams across cultures.

Job Description:

Job Family Definition:
Leads the sales community to success. Communicates direction to the team in line with the company’s vision and strategy. Inspires the team to meet and exceed goals. Manages the HPE sales motion towards growth and increased profitability. Creates a high performing team through recruiting, developing, and retaining talent. Organizes the team and adapts the resource mix to maximize the team’s and HPE’s achievement, market coverage and financial performance. Coaches to assure best in class individual and team sales performance. Orchestrates major Enterprise-level customer engagements to deliver results and create the best customer experience in the industry. Manages escalations to solution, and solution to opportunity. Drives a hunting mentality. Engages customer executives to understand the customers’ business context, build trust, and deliver HPE’s value proposition in line with that. Creates early stage opportunities by managing top customers’ executive level relationships. Coaches and enables teams to craft the right technical, IT investment and pricing strategies to win. Partners with stakeholders to maximize cross-HPE team efficiency and customer success. Helps teams to bust barriers and overcome obstacles. Establishes sales methodology for end-to-end sales process management. Manages sales planning, and follows up to ensure consistent execution. Provides timely and accurate sales forecasts. Provides customer feedback and won/loss deal analysis into the broader HPE team.
Management Level Definition:
Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to manage staff activities in solving common and complex business/technical issues within established policies. Manages non-exempt/exempt individual contributors and/or supervisors. Has accountability for results of a major program in terms of cost, direction and people management. Provides guidance on process improvements and recommends changes in alignment with business tactics and strategy for area of responsibility. Plans, manages and monitors operational/tactical activities of Staff. Staff members' work may involve strategic issues. Recruits and supports development of direct staff members.

Sales Manager – Transactional Sales

Lead and develop a high performing sales team to drive revenue growth through disciplined sales execution, strong pipeline management, operational excellence and effective demand generation.

Sales Target Ownership:
Deliver revenue, margin and volume targets through high-velocity transactional sales.
Sales Execution: Drive day-to-day sales execution, ensuring strong conversion, deal closure and achievement of targets.
Pipeline Management : Maintain a healthy pipeline, track opportunities and improve conversion rates and sales velocity.
Partner/Customer Management : Manage relationships with transactional partners, resellers and customers to maximise sales opportunities.
Demand Generation : Drive promotions, campaigns, bundles and sales plays that generate immediate demand and accelerate sell-through.
Forecasting : Provide accurate weekly/monthly sales forecasts and proactively manage gaps against target.
Performance Management : Track KPIs such as revenue, bookings, margin, conversion, average deal size, win rate and sales velocity.
Sales Productivity : Improve sales processes, tools and routines to increase productivity and reduce sales-cycle time.
Channel Coverage : Identify gaps in customer/partner coverage and ensure sufficient sales reach across priority segments.
Cross-functional Execution : Work closely with marketing, distribution, operations and finance to maximise sales.
Team Leadership : Coach the sales team, establish clear targets and create a strong accountability and performance culture.
Operational Excellence : Ensure disciplined CRM usage, accurate reporting, timely follow-up and consistent sales processes.
Growth Opportunities : Identify new products, customers, partners and routes to market that can generate incremental revenue.

Business Management.
- Strategic Planning - Translates business goals into actionable plans and strategies that reflect the requirements and opportunities within area-of-control Aligns area-of-control account and market opportunities with upstream strategic plans and metrics. Sets sales priorities and establishing these as the focus of individual or sales team activities.
- Execution - Actively manages business plans to meet revenue goals/quotes and advance the business interests of the company. Determines if an opportunity is profitable for the company.
- Forecast/Budget Control - Tracks and manages rolling forecasts and budgets to ensure timely and accurate roll-ups.
- Pipeline Management - Builds, monitors and orchestrates sales pipelines to ensure continuous population of near- and long-term opportunities Balances quick wins against longer sales-cycle opportunities to ensure both immediate wins and long-term profitability for the company.
- Operations Building/Improvement - Continuously monitors, troubleshoots and improves area-of-control operations to ensure alignment with the company's business direction, the quality of business practices, optimum organizational performance and a highly motivated sales force.

Workforce Management & Development.
- Supervision - Assesses and manages employee performance to ensure individual and group excellence Builds individual and group commitment to business goals and personal excellence.
- Coaching - Personally develops employee performance to ensure individual and group excellence. Coaches and develops sales personnel in such activities as solution selling or relationship building. Reviews, brainstorms, validates, and troubleshoots selling strategies for individuals & account teams.
- Skill Development/Enhancement - Sponsors and directs skill building activities to increase the productivity and accomplishments of the sales force.
- Workforce Planning - Actively monitors, identifies and addresses sales and resource capability gaps within area-of-control Manages "span of control" issues to ensure such goals as adequate account coverage, employee retention, effective succession planning, and optimum implementation of workforce re- alignment models.
- Career Planning and Development - Nurtures and advances the talent required to maintain the company's sales force excellence within area-of-control.

Strategic Business Planning.
- Manages the top- and bottom-line - monitors discounts and margins involved in individual deals to align them with group performance.
- Works with others to create mechanisms that shift the focus from "low- hanging," immediate wins to recognizing and providing incentives for large deals/wins.
- Understands industry drivers and the customer base better to bridge company solutions with account-relevant problems and opportunities.
- Builds stronger internal relationships with other groups to ensure seamless selling of total company solutions and to establish clear expectations for resource alignment and support.
- develop effective counter-measures and messages.
- Builds clear strategies for working with key accounts to pursue and close major opportunities, including clear identification of tactics for accelerating progress through the pipeline.

Leadership

Able to lead effectively in a complex environment, and deliver results; Able to influence without direct authority; Able to balance between competing priorities and be flexible and creative; Drives team performance to best in class.

Education and Experience Required:
- Directly related management experience and work results including success in achieving progressively higher quota or other sales related goals.
- Demonstrated level of project management skills.
- University or Bachelor's degree.
- Typically 10+ years experience in sales.

Job Description:

Overview
We are seeking an accomplished Manager of Sales – Digital Sales to lead the digital go-to-market efforts for HPE VM Essentials. This role combines driving sales with strong emphasis on channel/partner, strategic forecasting, demand generation campaigns, team leadership, and rep development to drive sustainable revenue growth in the dynamic virtualization and IT infrastructure market. The ideal candidate will be data-driven, customer-obsessed, and adept at partnering with product, marketing, and customer success to accelerate adoption of HPE VM Essentials.

About HPE VM Essentials
HPE VM Essentials is a scalable, cost-efficient virtualization and VM management solution designed for businesses seeking streamlined VM operations, robust security, and simplified cloud integrations. The Manager of Sales – Digital Sales will oversee digital selling motions that convert inbound and outbound digital engagement into qualified opportunities and closed deals.

Key Responsibilities
1) Forecasting & Pipeline Management
- Develop and maintain accurate monthly/quarterly forecasts for digital sales tied to HPE VM Essentials.
- Define, track, and report on key pipeline metrics (SQLs, MQLs, conversion rates, velocity, average deal size, win rate).
- Establish and manage a robust digital funnel with clear stages, SLAs, and accountability.
- Use data analytics to identify gaps, risks, and upside opportunities; present data-driven recommendations to leadership.
- Collaborate with Finance and Marketing to ensure alignment on revenue targets, bookings, and budgets.

2) Digital Campaigns & Demand Generation
- Design and execute end-to-end digital sales campaigns (paid media, organic search, social, email nurture, webinars, content offers) to drive pipeline for HPE VM Essentials.
- Define ICPs, targeting, messaging, and value propositions tailored to different buyer personas (IT admins, VM admins, cloud architects, CIOs).
- Collaborate with Marketing to create landing pages, assets, and CTAs that maximize conversion across the funnel.
- Leverage ABM and intent-data strategies to accelerate engagement with high-priority accounts.
- Measure campaign ROIs, cost per opportunity, and contribution to pipeline; iterate based on results.

3) Leadership & Team Management
- Lead, coach, and mentor a team of Digital Sales Representatives and Sales Engineers (as applicable) to achieve or exceed quota.
- Set clear goals, performance metrics, and development plans; conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and recognition.
- Foster a high-performance culture with collaboration across marketing, product, and customer success.
- Hire, onboard, and ramp new team members; ensure ongoing skills development and certification.

4) Rep Development & Enablement
- Develop playbooks, scripts, and process flows for digital outreach, qualification, and handoff to close.
- Provide ongoing training on product features, competitive positioning, objection handling, and ROI storytelling for HPE VM Essentials.
- Implement sales coaching rhythms, call reviews, and battle cards to improve win rates.
- Equip reps with tools, dashboards, and enablement assets to increase efficiency and effectiveness.

5) Sales Operations & Process Improvement
- Standardize selling processes, cadences, and SLAs; ensure CRM hygiene and accurate data capture.
- Define and track performance dashboards; provide actionable insights to leadership and field teams.
- Collaborate with Product and Engineering to relay customer feedback and influence product roadmap for VM Essentials.
- Ensure compliance with company policies, pricing guidelines, and contractual frameworks.

6) Customer & Partner Alignment
- Build relationships with channel partners, MSPs, and strategic alliances that amplify digital reach for VM Essentials.
- Coordinate with Customer Success to ensure a smooth post-sale experience, renewal opportunities, and expansion into existing accounts.
- Advocate for customer-centric value realization, ROI, and TCO improvements.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, or related field; MBA or relevant advanced degree preferred.
- 8+ years of B2B software or IT infrastructure sales experience, with 5+ years strong track record in digital/e-commerce or inside sales leadership.
- Demonstrated success in forecasting, pipeline management, and quota attainment in a digital sales environment.
- Experience with virtualization, cloud management, or IT infrastructure solutions (preferably HPE ecosystem) is highly desirable.
- Proficiency with CRM and marketing automation tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo), and analytics platforms.
- Strong analytical mindset; ability to translate data into actionable strategies.
- Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills; able to articulate ROI and business value to technical and executive audiences.
- Leadership experience: coaching, recruiting, performance management, and team development.
- Strong collaboration skills across marketing, product, sales operations, and finance.

Desired Skills & Competencies
- Strategic thinker with a data-driven approach to forecasting and pipeline optimization.
- Customer-centric mindset with ability to build trusted relationships at multiple levels.
- Change management and adaptability in a fast-paced market.
- Problem-solving orientation; comfortable challenging the status quo and testing new approaches.
- Cross-functional collaborator who can influence without direct authority.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. Job Description:

This position is for an existing vacancy. All interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

As a  Enterprise Sales Manager  you will manage a sales team across eastern Canada. You will report into the VP Enterprise sales and will apply your expert subject matter knowledge to manage your team's activities in solving the most complex business & technical issues. You will have accountability for leading portfolio sales teams across major Eastern Canadian customers with significant impact on strategic business unit results and organizational strategy.  You will also act as a key advisor to senior management on the development of overall policies and long-term goals of the organization. If you have a track record of technology sales success, want to be part of a business area that is growing—with great opportunities, and are ready for your next role, then please apply today!

How you’ll make your mark:
• You will lead the sales community to success. Communicate effectively to set direction for the team in line with the company’s vision and strategy.
• You will inspire the team to meet and exceed goals whilst managing the HPE CMS sales motion strategy and deployment towards growth and increased profitability.
• Engage with key customer executives (CEO, CFO, COO) to understand the customers’ business context and build trust. Coach and guide team members to develop and deliver HPE value proposition in line with the customer's business priorities.
• Create early stage opportunities by managing top customers’ executive level relationships.
• Recruit and develop your team – coaching them to craft the right technical, IT and Network investment, pricing and sales strategies to win.
• Orchestrate major Enterprise-level customer engagements for HPE to make sure we deliver  results through the best customer experience in the Telecom Industry.
• Establish sales methodology for end-to-end sales process management, with clear roles and responsibilities in each stage of the sales process.
• Manage strategic and tactical sales planning at both segment and account levels, considering the intersection of technology, people and economics. Follow up to ensure consistent execution.

About you
•  University or Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent experience
•  15+ years of experience in IT sales , including success in achieving progressively higher quotas and other sales goals.
• 10+ years of experience managing high-performing sales teams
•  Demonstrate excellence in project management.

Gestionnaire de vente entreprise

En tant que responsable des ventes aux entreprises, vous dirigerez une équipe de vente à travers l'est du Canada. Sous la supervision du vice-président des ventes aux entreprises, vous mettrez à profit votre expertise pour piloter les activités de votre équipe et résoudre les problèmes techniques et commerciaux les plus complexes. Vous serez responsable de diriger les équipes de vente de portefeuille auprès de grands clients de l'est canadien, avec un impact significatif sur les résultats de l'unité commerciale stratégique et sur la stratégie de l'organisation.Vous agirez également à titre de conseiller clé auprès de la haute direction concernant l'élaboration des politiques générales et des objectifs à long terme de l'organisation. Si vous avez fait vos preuves dans la vente de technologies, souhaitez évoluer au sein d'un secteur d'activité en pleine croissance offrant d'excellentes perspectives, et êtes prêt(e) à relever un nouveau défi, postulez dès aujourd'hui !

Votre contribution :

• Vous dirigerez l'équipe des ventes vers le succès. Vous communiquerez efficacement pour définir l'orientation de l'équipe, conformément à la vision et à la stratégie de l'entreprise.
• Vous inspirerez l'équipe à atteindre et surpasser ses objectifs, tout en pilotant la stratégie et le déploiement des ventes de HPE CMS pour favoriser la croissance et la rentabilité.
• Collaborer avec les principaux dirigeants clients (PDG, DAF, DG) pour comprendre leur contexte commercial et instaurer un climat de confiance. Accompagner et former les membres de l'équipe pour élaborer et mettre en œuvre la proposition de valeur HPE en adéquation avec les priorités commerciales du client.
• Identifier les opportunités en phase de démarrage en gérant les relations avec les dirigeants des clients stratégiques.
• Recruter et développer votre équipe : la former à élaborer les stratégies techniques, informatiques et réseau, tarifaires et commerciales les plus pertinentes pour remporter des contrats.
• Orchestrer les interactions majeures avec les grands comptes pour HPE afin d'assurer des résultats concrets grâce à une expérience client optimale dans le secteur des télécommunications.
• Mettre en place une méthodologie de vente pour la gestion de l'ensemble du processus de vente, avec des rôles et des responsabilités clairement définis à chaque étape.
• Gérer la planification stratégique et opérationnelle des ventes, tant au niveau du segment que du compte, en tenant compte des interactions entre technologie, ressources humaines et économie. Assurer un suivi rigoureux pour une mise en œuvre cohérente.

À propos de vous

• Diplôme universitaire (licence ou équivalent) souhaité
• Plus de 15 ans d'expérience dans la vente de solutions informatiques, avec des résultats probants en matière d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux croissants

Job Description:

HPE Networking  will unleash the power of the combined HPE Aruba Networking and Juniper Networking solutions, creating a market-leading portfolio designed to address a broad range of customer segments, from small and mid-sized businesses to the world’s largest enterprises. HPE Networking's innovative technology, AI-driven networking solutions, and open, standards-based approach are resonating with customers globally as organizations modernize their infrastructure for the cloud and AI era.
The   Northern California Enterprise Sales Director   is a key leadership role within HPE Networking, responsible for leading a high-performing team of sellers focused on driving growth across large enterprise accounts (outside of the Fortune 250) and strategic Neocloud customers. This leader will develop and execute a comprehensive go-to-market strategy, build strong customer and partner relationships, and guide the team in identifying, developing, and closing opportunities that accelerate HPE Networking’s market share and revenue growth throughout the region.
This role requires a sales leader who can inspire and develop talent, drive disciplined pipeline management, and engage directly with senior customer executives to position HPE Networking's portfolio of networking, AI infrastructure, and cloud solutions to solve complex business and technology challenges.

Managing the Business:
- Sales coverage - Builds well targeted business plans and strategies for allocating resources and driving sales activities to achieve margin; collaborates within the company and with the field to prioritize, facilitate and direct the use of resources.

- Account Planning - Assists in planning sales strategy; manages the internal processes in support of sales reps and selling activities; aligns tactical account plans with overall corporate strategy; actively develops and manages geography business plans to meet revenue goals/quotas; develops plans that articulate the strategies/requirements essential for focusing sales activities, forecasts accurately and communicates sales progress; actively manages and signs off on account business plans through scheduled reviews and updates.

- Pipeline management - Builds, monitors and orchestrates sales pipelines to ensure continuous population of near and long term opportunities; manages the size, shape and quality of pipeline; analyzes overall win rates and win/loss ratios.

- Deal management - Reviews deals to ensure soundness and problem-free processing by the company's back-end operations; Monitors the number of deals with TAS plan reviewed by managers.

- Business acumen - Exhibits base level of business, financial and legal acumen to develop meaningful business recommendations; continuously monitors and improves area-of-control operations to ensure alignment with the company's business direction, the quality of business practices and optimum organization performance.

- Strategic sales planning & implementation - Orchestrates the development of strategic sales plans that reflect the company's business strategy, to advance market share/penetration, and achieve profitable growth.

- Competitive Positioning/Strategy - Uses competitive intelligence in account planning and sales activities to develop counter strategies that will neutralize competitive influence on the customer's buying decisions.

Leading & Managing Sales People:
- Coaching & Performance Management - Assesses and manages employee performance to ensure individual and group excellence; counsels and supports individuals through selling challenges; manages performance and results of individuals through selling challenges; manages performance and results of high and low performers.

- Leadership - Models effective selling skills; motivates and supports sales teams in selling; demonstrates a high level of support in the pursuit and closing of deals.

- People development - Nurtures and advances the talent required to maintain the company's sales force excellence within area of control; sponsors and directs skill building activities to increase the productivity and accomplishments of the sales force.

- Change management - Ability to work through an environment of change and effectively lead a sales team through transitions beyond their control.

Selling as a Sales Manager:
- Focus on strategic direction - Understands the overall company/TSG strategic direction and portfolio, and can assist sales teams in customizing solutions based on client needs.

- C-level partnering - Contributes to enduring executive relationships at the highest levels of the client's organization; personally interacts with executives; establishes professional relationships and credibility with key IT and business executives in support of other established relationships with the client.

- Consultative selling - Strategizes and coaches team on how to apply consultative-selling techniques to identify and advance opportunities that result in ongoing profitable revenue growth for the company; prepares for client calls in partnership with sales teams and supports the efforts of the team during client meetings; ensures sales teams have access to other company resources and encourages them to nurture relationships with client influencers and decision makers.

- Industry and client knowledge - Stays current with industry and competitive research and information to enable rich client dialogue; maintains an understanding of client business challenges, industry trends and markets; demonstrates breadth and depth of knowledge to position and map company capabilities that align to client business objectives and initiatives.

Education and Experience Required:
- Directly related management experience and work results including success in achieving progressively higher quota or other sales related goals.

- Demonstrated level of project management skills.

- University or Bachelor's degree.

- Typically 7+ years experience in sales.

Knowledge and Skills:

In addition to core selling skills:

Business Management:
- Strategic Planning - Translates business goals into actionable plans and strategies that reflect the requirements and opportunities within area-of-control Aligns area-of-control account and market opportunities with upstream strategic plans and metrics. Sets sales priorities and establishing these as the focus of individual or sales team activities.

- Execution - Actively manages business plans to meet revenue goals/quotes and advance the business interests of the company. Determines if an opportunity is profitable for the company.

- Forecast/Budget Control - Tracks and manages rolling forecasts and budgets to ensure timely and accurate roll-ups.

- Pipeline Management - Builds, monitors and orchestrates sales pipelines to ensure continuous population of near- and long-term opportunities Balances quick wins against longer sales-cycle opportunities to ensure both immediate wins and long-term profitability for the company.

- Operations Building/Improvement - Continuously monitors, troubleshoots and improves area-of-control operations to ensure alignment with the company's business direction, the quality of business practices, optimum organizational performance and a highly motivated sales force.

Sales Development:
- Resource Brokering/Allocation - Collaborates across the company within the field to access, facilitate and direct the use of resources needed for effective selling.

- Sales Facilitation - Applies influence and organizational savvy to advances.

Strategic Business Planning:
- Manages the top- and bottom-line - monitors discounts and margins involved in individual deals to align them with group performance.

- Works with others to create mechanisms that shift the focus from "low- hanging," immediate wins to recognizing and providing incentives for large deals/wins.

- Understands industry drivers and the customer base better to bridge company solutions with account-relevant problems and opportunities.

- Builds stronger internal relationships with other groups to ensure seamless selling of total company solutions and to establish clear expectations for resource alignment and support.

- Develop effective counter-measures and messages.

- Builds clear strategies for working with key accounts to pursue and close major opportunities, including clear identification of tactics for accelerating progress through the pipeline.

You will help align stakeholders on the deliverables and decisions required to successfully execute strategic partnerships.

You will support partner targeting, business-case development, deal structuring, contract negotiations, and stakeholder management for priority solution areas identified as important to HPE Networking’s growth strategy. This role reports to the Vice President of Business Development responsible for Technology Alliances.
About the Team

You will join the Business Development Technology Alliances team within HPE Networking’s Strategy and Business Development organization. The team leads the planning, analysis, and execution of technology alliance and solution programs across HPE Networking’s portfolio, including routing, switching, security, wireless LAN, and software solutions.

- Developing financial models, presentations, and executive-ready recommendations.
- Supporting additional strategic initiatives and analyses related to HPE Networking’s technology partner portfolio.

Job Description:

Job Family Definition:
Serves as a trusted adviser to the Partner and develops a mutually beneficial relationship in alignment with HPE business priorities. Drives end-to-end revenue, HPE profitability, and pipeline through joint business plans and data-driven sales efforts. Articulates both HPE global and local business strategies to effectively “sell with”, “sell to”, and “sell through” the Partner, creating a scalable selling ecosystem. Develops knowledge of Partner priorities, industry trends, IT landscape, IT investment strategy, HPE priorities, and HPE Technology to differentiate HPE from competitors. Coordinates and executes HPE activities with the Partner, leveraging HPE specialists when needed. Aligns field sales to drive increased value to HPE for pipeline and revenue/profit growth while leveraging the collective strength of the partner ecosystem. Leads HPE strategy, programs, and systems with and on behalf of the Partner to assure accelerated financial outcomes and build partner loyalty to HPE. These jobs focus on selling to customers through the Partner as an extension of HPE's salesforce, typically through work that occurs outside HPE offices.
Management Level Definition:
Unique mastery and authority on relevant subject matter knowledge including technologies, theories and techniques. Contributes to the development of innovative principles and ideas. Successfully operates in the most complex disciplines, in which the company must operate to be successful. Provides highly innovative solutions. Leads large, cross-division projects that affect the organization's long-term goals and objectives. May participate in cross-division, multi-function teams. Provides guidance to fellow employees. Routinely exercises independent judgment in developing methods, techniques and criteria for achieving objectives. Develops strategy and acts as a functional manager within area of expertise but does not manage other employees as a primary job function.
Responsibilities:
- Execution of a Sales program aligned to the GTM strategy, with the objective to grow revenue and market share in the SMB/MM space. Evaluate, re-define & deploy when needed
- Drive interlock governance and cadence with the Regions and Global stakeholders, to maximize program performance.
- Own the sales program forecast and drives execution with regional RTM counterparts
- Review partner selection/co-selling/activation/joint business planning
- Performs analysis as required to drive RTM activities such as competitive activity (spending trends, website content/presentation, promotional offerings) and synthesis of syndicated and/or primary research.
- Tracks/report program metrics versus predetermined goals/ benchmarks.
- Conducts Analysis and summarizes complex data to makes sales play recommendations
- Assists with development & review of sales training materials. Audit content quality (complete, up-to-date, and compelling) on our portal and partner sites - interlock with regions/marketing/agency
- Provide input into the Readiness annual process including coverage/productivity guidance/KPIs and sales priorities. Ensure program quota distribution in accordance with guidelines

- Serves as a trusted advisor and expert to the Partner (e.g. Value Added Reseller (VAR), Distributor, SI, ISV, Managed Service Provider) on where to play within emerging trends in Partner's ecosystem in alignment with HPE business priorities. Works with the Partner to create a mutually beneficial plan for the future.
- Drives end-to end HPE revenue, profitability, and pipeline by creating joint business plans and leading data-driven sales efforts with the Partner.
- Articulates both HPE global and local business strategies to effectively "sell with," "sell to," and "sell through" the Partner, creating a scalable selling ecosystem. Tailors solutions to influence the broader Partner ecosystem.
- Develops thorough knowledge of partner priorities, industry trends, IT landscape, IT investment strategy, HPE priorities, and HPE Technology and communicates value of the portfolios and solutions to better differentiate HPE from competitors.
- Demonstrates business and sales leadership by building mutually beneficial, executive-level relationships with one or many Partners to grow HPE market share.
- Coordinates and executes HPE activities with the Partner, leveraging HPE specialists when needed, including sales cadence, education, marketing, executive briefings, proactive forecasting, business planning, and client engagements. Drives HPE marketing strategy through the customer.
- Drives account mapping process with the Partner and HPE Sales teams to align field sales. Promotes increased value to HPE for pipeline and revenue/profit growth while leveraging the collective strength of the partner ecosystem.
- Leads and implements HPE strategy, programs, and systems with and on behalf of the Partner to assure accelerated financial outcomes and build partner loyalty to HPE. Influences Partner to drive increased number of sellers, Solution Architects, and other Partner resources to HPE portfolio.
- Tailors selling solutions to fit the needs of the partner's customer profile including HPE products, services and technology alliances to achieve assigned quota.
- May recruit and develop business relationships with new partners, working to increase partner commitment to HPE.
- May spend time monitoring Partner sales floor to help develop pipeline.
- Works to ensure that partners are aware of, and compliant with, HPE's SBC requirements for Partners, including applicable legal obligations.

Education and Experience:
- University or Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
- Typically 10+ years of selling experience at end-user account or partner level.
- Experience selling to partners in a complex environment.

Knowledge and Skills:
- Technology Acumen: Thorough awareness of current technology trends and related HPE strategy and ability to articulate same to Partner.
- Sales Acumen: Able to influence the partner to take actions that create increased value to HPE. Effectively exercises selling skills such as identifying potential opportunities, utilizing appropriate sales platforms and resources, and formulating and proposing solutions with the goal of expanding HPE's business. Acts with a sense of urgency to build strong customer relationships and drive solutions for the partner.
- Account Management: Thorough understanding of business and financial fundamentals to develop strategic plans with the partner that are aligned to customer and HPE strategies, creating increased business opportunities and value for HPE.
- Portfolio Knowledge: Thorough understanding of HPE products and how they can deliver value to customers in contrast to HPE's competitors. Ability to select the best product for the customer's needs, maximizing value for both the customer and HPE. Trend-setter for new HPE products and initiatives, focusing on driving sales of newer, high-margin products and solutions to the customer.
- Partner Industry Acumen: Thorough understanding of Partner industry, trends, competitors, and the channel. Considered a subject matter expert for the Partner industry.
- Partnering Acumen: Builds understanding of and relationships with partner and internal community among all types and levels of the business, integrating sales engagement efforts. Thorough understanding of the Partner's relationships and needs.
- Negotiation and Conflict Management: Ability to achieve agreement within business contexts, and resolve issues so that every party is satisfied.
- Financial Acumen: Thorough understanding of financial accounting concepts such as income statements, balance sheets, revenue projections, etc. to assess customer financial health, identify potential risks, and position value propositions of HPE solutions.
- Sales Forecasting: Ability to look forward and anticipate partner needs, proactively forecasting sales quota and effectively bridging sales gaps.
- Communication: Professional, clear, and effective verbal and written communication.
- Time Management: Ability to prioritize and effectively meet deadlines.
- Creativity and Entrepreneurship: Ability to innovate, think beyond proscribed solutions, and take proactive steps to advance HPE sales efforts.

Job Definition:
The HPE Networking Supply Chain Transformation & Enablement Office ensures the delivery of highly effective end-to-end system and integrated process solutions to meet the goals and objectives of Networking Supply Chain Operations (SCO).  The Business Systems Analyst will act as a hybrid Supply Chain Systems SME and Project Lead, responsible for driving process alignment and system enhancements across demand, supply, inventory and material planning, S&OP, and fulfilment teams in the Networking Supply Chain Operations Team. The BSA will additionally be responsible for business systems support. Key to success for this position will be strong project management leadership.

Management Level Definition:
Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Frequently contributes to the development of new ideas and methods. Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors. Leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Acts as an expert providing direction and guidance to process improvements and establishing policies. Frequently represents the organization to external customers/clients. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for accomplishing work and achieving objectives. May provide mentoring and guidance to lower level employees.

How will you make your mark
- Lead end-to-end supply chain planning system initiatives, including enhancements, integrations, and new solution deployments across Oracle and SAP
- Drive requirements definition and user acceptance testing in partnership with business and IT stakeholders
- Manage project timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment across Planning, Fulfilment, and IT teams
- Identify and resolve data, process, and system integration gaps across Oracle and SAP landscapes
- Own testing strategy, defect resolution, and deployment readiness for system changes
- Support enterprise supply chain transformation initiatives

About you
- BA or BS Degree or 7-10+ years equivalent experience
- Expertise in Planning systems implementation, experience with Oracle Supply Chain Cloud required.
- SAP Order Management, AATP, and Backlog Management preferred.
- EDI management and implementation.
- Project Management experience required, including IT-interfacing roles.
- Experience in a Supply Chain operational role, preferably in Demand Planning, Supply Planning, MRP or Inventory Planning.
- Knowledge of Manufacturing & Fulfilment with outsourced manufacturing and 3PL partners for high tech multi-level BOMs.
- Experience in Project Management software such as JIRA, Service Now, MS Project
- Experience in Business Process mapping and documentation
- PMP a plus

Knowledge and Skills:
- Deep expertise of Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain modules, including Demand Management, Supply Planning and Sales & Operations Planning
- Working knowledge of SAP S4/ECC processes, especially in Order Management and AATP
- Strong program/project management capability with demonstrated delivery ownership
- Ability to act as SME and bridge between business and IT
- Broad Supply Chain Operations business knowledge, including Demand Planning, Material Planning, Supply Planning, MRP and Build Plan, Order Scheduling, Backlog Management, Inventory Management, Logistics, Warehouse Management and Cost Management.
- General knowledge of End-to-End Supply Chain flow in the Manufacturing tech industry and stakeholders involved at every stage.
- Comfortable using AI and developing new use cases.
- Strong data & analytics tools experience, with a focus on supply chain reporting.
- Strong communication skills. Ability to summarize project status effectively to leadership, to engage collaboratively with resources across various internal and external teams, and to escalate appropriately to resolve gaps and enable quick decision making.

Job Description:

About the Position:
Are you energized by solving complex supply chain challenges and ensuring critical semiconductor components are available when and where they are needed? We are seeking a highly analytical, results-driven Commodity Planning & Procurement Manager II to lead component planning for HPE Networking sustaining semiconductor and memory products. This role owns component supply health through forecasting, procurement, inventory management, supplier collaboration, and risk mitigation, ensuring continuity of supply in a fast-paced, high-complexity environment.
Working across suppliers, distributors, ODM/CM partners, procurement, engineering, and operations teams, you will drive supply strategies, identify risks before they impact production, and execute solutions that optimize cost, inventory, and customer delivery.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead fulfillment strategies across component suppliers, distributors/3PLs, ODM/CM partners, and internal teams, including developing and executing procurement strategies.
- Drive inventory management and improve turns in a dynamic environment while resolving shortages with urgency and precision.
- Lead co‑planning/CPFR activities with suppliers, including enhancing, automating, and maintaining reporting tools and performance dashboards.

- Own component forecasting and supply health metrics, proactively identifying risks and executing mitigation strategies to ensure uninterrupted production

- Resolve component shortages by coordinating with suppliers, procurement, engineering, and operations teams.
- Lead supply reporting, including dashboards, shortage summaries, and executive‑level updates.

- Own procurement execution activities including purchase order management, lead-time tracking, supplier commitments, and supply continuity planning.

- Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, forecast risks, and drive strategic actions.
- Support cost‑reduction and process‑improvement initiatives across the supply chain.

Required Qualifications
- Deep understanding of semiconductor commodities including silicon, wireless, FPGA, CPU and memory supply chains, including lead-time management, allocation environments, lifecycle planning, and supplier engagement strategies.
- Advanced analytical skills, including Excel (pivot tables, Power Query, complex formulas, dashboards). Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools is preferred

- Experience in material management, demand planning, direct procurement or supply chain operations.
- Strong understanding of component‑level supply chains, ideally in high‑tech hardware.
- Proven ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
- Excellent communication, presentation and collaboration skills.
- Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.
- Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle).

Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Business, Engineering, Operations, or a related field; advanced university degree preferred.
- 7+ years of experience in semiconductor supply chain, commodity management, demand/supply planning, procurement, or supply operations
- Background in networking, server, or hardware manufacturing environments.
- Process improvement mindset with experience driving operational efficiency.

What Success Looks Like
In this role, you will:
- Maintain continuity of supply across your assigned commodity portfolio.
- Improve forecast accuracy and supply visibility through effective planning, supplier collaboration, and risk management.
- Reduce component shortages and expedite costs through proactive supply monitoring and mitigation planning.
- Optimize inventory turns while maintaining appropriate supply coverage to support business requirements.
- Strengthen supplier performance by improving delivery reliability, commitment accuracy, and responsiveness.
- Identify and mitigate supply risks before they impact production, customer deliveries, or revenue.
- Deliver accurate and actionable reporting that enables effective decision-making and executive visibility.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning processes, reporting capabilities, and operational efficiency.
- Build strong partnerships across engineering, planning, operations, suppliers, and procurement teams to ensure rapid resolution of supply issues.
- Serve as a trusted commodity expert, providing strategic recommendations that optimize supply, inventory, cost, and customer fulfillment.

This position is ideal for a supply chain professional who enjoys owning commodity-level supply health, developing supplier partnerships, solving complex semiconductor supply challenges, and driving business results through data-driven decision-making.

カスタマーサクセスアーキテクト（Customer Success Architect）は、カスタマーサクセスチームにおける技術的なリーダーとして、お客様による OpsRamp および HPE CloudOps スイート製品の活用促進とベストプラクティスの定着を推進する役割を担います。

- 顧客のユースケースおよび製品機能に関する信頼できるアドバイザーとして活動する。
- 顧客のビジネス成果（Business Outcomes）を実現するために、HPE CloudOps スイートの製品およびサービス活用をリードする。ホワイトボードセッションを実施しながらソリューションやユースケースの設計・アーキテクチャ策定を支援し、技術的・組織的な障壁の解消を支援する。
- トレーニングや実務経験を通じて、OpsRamp、Zerto、Morpheus などの HPE CloudOps ソフトウェア、そのアーキテクチャおよび機能に関する深い理解を習得する。
- 導入フェーズで設計された技術設計・アーキテクチャを基盤として、顧客ごとの最新アーキテクチャを維持・管理する。
- 職務範囲や専門領域を超える課題であっても積極的に問題解決に取り組み、エスカレーション対応および顧客期待値の管理を行う。
- 顧客の技術的要件に関する重要な情報源として機能し、製品管理、エンジニアリング、マーケティングなどの社内部門へ顧客フィードバックを提供する。
- カスタマーサクセスライフサイクル全体を通じて、顧客環境におけるヘルスチェックを実施・管理する。
- 顧客のユースケースを理解・文書化し、各ユースケース向けのベストプラクティスやイネーブルメントコンテンツを作成する。
- 定期的なヘルスチェックを通じて現状を評価し、顧客が将来の理想状態を実現できるよう支援する。 顧客のユースケースを技術的に深く理解し、それらを HPE CloudOps スイートの機能へマッピングできる能力を発揮する。
- リニューアルチームと連携し、顧客が HPE CloudOps スイートの契約更新を円滑に進められるよう支援する。
- サポート要件や機能改善要望を追跡し、迅速な課題解決のためにプロダクトチームおよびエンジニアリングチームと連携する。
- 顧客企業の技術系エグゼクティブ層に対して、迅速に技術的な信頼と専門性を確立する。
- ベストプラクティスの文書化、ナレッジの収集・共有、および HPE CloudOps スイートの成長につながる各種イニシアチブに積極的に取り組む。

Customer Success Manager/Turkish Speaker (m/w/d)

This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) ist ein führendes IT-Unternehmen, das es seinen Kunden ermöglicht, technologisch immer einen Schritt voraus zu sein. Durch das umfassende Portfolio – von Lösungen für Cloud, Rechenzentren und Arbeitsplatzanwendungen– gestalten unsere Technologien und Services weltweit die IT unserer Kunden effizienter, produktiver und sicherer.
Für unser Sales Center im Herzen Berlins, suchen wir Dich als Digital Sales - Customer Success Manager (w/m/d) mit Fokus auf Cloud & Infrastructure Vertrieb für Bestandskunden in der Türkei .
Unser DCSM-Team betreut aus Berlin heraus as-a-Service-Bestandskunden in Central Europe und verantwortet bei diesen Up- und Cross-Selling-Aktivitäten.
In dieser Rolle wirst Du mit unseren Produkten das Beste aus den Lösungen unserer Kunden machen und wirst dich dem Erfolg unserer Kunden widmest. Du stellst sicher, dass sie von unseren Lösungen bestmöglich profitieren.
Deine Benefits – Was wir dir bieten:
- Onboarding & Entwicklung : Ein strukturiertes, mehrwöchiges Onboarding inklusive Sales-Trainings ermöglicht Dir einen direkten Start bei HPE sowie eine international anerkannte Zertifizierung im Customer Success Bereich
- Flexibilität & Balance: Neben 30 Tagen Urlaub profitierst Du von 4 zusätzlichen „Wellness Fridays“. Hybrides Arbeiten ist bei uns gelebte Praxis.
- Sicherheit & Wachstum: Du erhältst einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag in einem Umfeld, das Eigenverantwortung und eine moderne „Fail-Fast“-Lernkultur fördert.
- Vergütung & Incentives: Attraktives Zielgehalt von 50k – 65k € im 80/20 Split (je nach relevanter Vorerfahrung) mit 100% Garantie-Provision in den ersten 3 Monaten sowie ungedeckelter variabler Vergütung mit attraktiven Boni bei Zielübererreichung.
- Exzellente Infrastruktur: Arbeite in unseren modernen Design Offices am Ku’Damm – inklusive Dachterrasse, Barista-Kaffee und regelmäßigen Team-Events.
- Gelebte Diversity: Werde Teil unserer Employee Resource Groups (z. B. Women’s Network, Pride ERG) und finde Raum für Austausch und Empowerment.
- Umfangreiche Add-ons: Zuschuss zur BVG-Monatskarte (ABC/Deutschland Ticket), 400€/Jahr MachtFit Budget, JobRad , ca. 100€/Monat Lunchit Guthaben, 60h/Jahr für soziales Engagement (vollbezahlt) und vieles mehr

Deine Aufgaben – Das wirst du bei uns bewegen:
- Strategische Betreuung : Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für deine Kund:innen rund um das HPE‑as‑a‑Service‑Portfolio.
- Wachstumstreiber: Du identifizierst Up‑ und Cross‑Sell‑Potenziale und unterstützt Kund:innen bei der Erweiterung ihrer Infrastruktur.
- Customer Journey Management : Du begleitest die Schweizer Bestandskund:innen vom Onboarding bis zur Skalierung in neue Geschäftsbereiche – mit Fokus auf nachhaltigem Geschäftserfolg.
- Erfolgsplanung:  Du erstellst und pflegst Success-Pläne, um die Geschäftsziele deiner Kund:innen transparent zu machen und aktiv voranzutreiben.
- Networking & Zusammenarbeit:  Du arbeitest eng mit unseren internen Expert:innen zusammen, um gemeinsam den bestmöglichen Customer Outcome zu erreichen.

Dein Profil – Das bringst du idealerweise mit:
- Hintergrund:  Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung im betriebswirtschaftlichen, kaufmännischen oder einem ähnlichen Fach. Alternativ auch 1-3 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im IT‑Vertrieb, Customer Success, aaS oder Cloud Infrastructure
- Sprachen:  Sehr gute Deutsch- und Türkischkenntnisse auf C2 Level sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mind. B2/C1 Level
- Persönlichkeit:  Du hörst aktiv zu und bist empathisch. Dabei arbeitest Du lösungsorientiert und hast eine starke Affinität zu IT‑Themen. Deine hohe Lernbereitschaft & klare Kommunikation in Wort und Schrift zeichnen Dich aus. Zudem triffst Du Entscheidungen lieber faktenbasiert (Zahlen, Daten, Insights) als aus dem Bauch heraus.

Wir haben Dein Interesse geweckt?
Dann bewirb Dich gleich bei HPE und werde Teil des Teams.
Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

Facebook - Instagram  - Twitter

jobs.location: Sunnyvale, California, United States of America

NPI Sourcing Manager, Sunnyvale, CA

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

As a New Product Introduction (NPI) Sourcing Manager, you will be a strategic leader in technical sourcing and supplier relationship management for HPE Networking’s most innovative products. You will drive cross-functional collaboration, ensure supply chain resilience, and champion operational excellence to deliver HPE Networking’s four Strategic Pillars Products.
As we look to deliver new technology to help our customers, we have embedded a strategic sourcing approach within Supplier Management and Procurement (SM&P) team. As a part of this, you'll be impacting the achievement of business objectives including technology and product improvements, and problem resolutions. Working with Engineering, Program Management and SM&P teams, you'll influence suppliers and are confident in negotiations ensuring quality and timely delivery. Taking ownership - supporting, leading, and handling the early engagement of key suppliers. Leading NPI project cost target, identifying and mitigating cost and schedule risks during development and ensuring a smooth transition towards volume manufacturing. Work closely with Global Commodity Managers (GCM) to align sourcing activities and objectives to the commodity strategies, and drive business leverage and early supplier engagement in new product development.

US Citizenship required
Hybrid Work: Must work in an HPE office 1 or 2 times a week. Work could be in Sunnyvale, San Jose or Roseville
Primary work location: Sunnyvale, California with occasional travel to other HPE offices in San Jose and Roseville, California
Travel: Possible international travel once a year. Candidate should have an active passport

Key Responsibilities
1. Innovation
- Lead early supplier engagement and technical sourcing for new product programs, ensuring access to cutting-edge technologies and components.

- Collaborate with R&D, Engineering, and HW Program Management to identify and qualify suppliers capable of supporting advanced product requirements.

- Drive continuous improvement and adoption of new sourcing strategies, tools, and digital platforms to accelerate time-to-market.

2. Customer Centricity
- Serve as the primary sourcing focal point in NPI core teams, ensuring supplier performance aligns with customer expectations for quality, responsiveness, and delivery.

- Proactively manage supplier relationships to resolve issues, mitigate risks, and ensure reliable supply for critical customer programs.

- Gather and act on feedback from internal and external stakeholders to improve sourcing processes and outcomes.

3. Operational Excellence
- Ensure supplier compliance with HPE metrics (Technology, Quality, Responsiveness, Delivery, Cost, Geo-diversification, BCP, Cybersecurity).

- Lead the Materials List Review (MLR) process and manage component-level cost and schedule impacts for assigned NPI programs.

- Drive accountability for on-time delivery through clear escalation paths and leadership engagement.

4. Sustainability
- Support supplier compliance with HPE’s sustainability and Net Zero Carbon initiatives, ensuring responsible sourcing and environmental stewardship.

- Collaborate with suppliers to implement sustainable practices and contribute to HPE’s Living Progress goals.

Knowledge & Skills
- Some program management experience required
- Supply Chain experience required
- Some engineering and networking product experience required with routers and switches, etc.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience
- Bachelor's Degree in engineering, supply chain management, or equivalent experience.

- 10+ years of experience

- Demonstrated experience in the semiconductor or high-tech industry.
